title: U.S. Recruiter
description:
**About Ekdant Technologies**

Ekdant Technologies is a growing IT staffing firm specializing in connecting top technology talent with clients across the United States. We work with businesses of all sizes to fulfill their most critical workforce needs, from software development and cloud infrastructure to data engineering and enterprise applications.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented U.S. Recruiter to join our team in Naroda, Ahmedabad. This is a great opportunity for someone eager to build a career in staffing within the IT space. You will work closely with Senior Recruiters and Account Managers to source, screen, and place qualified consultants for active client requirements across a range of technology disciplines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Full\-Cycle Recruiting Support — Assist in sourcing, screening, and coordinating interviews for IT contract positions across client accounts
* Candidate Sourcing — Utilize job boards (Dice, LinkedIn, Indeed, Monster), ATS tools, and networking to identify qualified candidates
* Pipeline Management — Maintain and update candidate records in the ATS; track submission, interview, and placement status consistently
* Screening \& Qualification — Conduct initial phone screens to evaluate candidates on technical background, work authorization, compensation expectations, and availability
* Bench Marketing Support — Coordinate with the bench sales team to match available consultants to open requirements from vendors and direct clients
* Job Order Management — Review and understand client requirements across key technology domains (Java, Python, .NET, SAP, Salesforce, DevOps, Data Engineering, Cloud, etc.)
* Candidate Engagement — Build relationships with active and passive candidates; maintain regular follow\-up to ensure strong placement ratios
* Compliance — Ensure all recruiting activities are compliant with EEO guidelines and U.S. employment regulations
* Collaboration — Work closely with Account Managers and Senior Recruiters to align candidate pipelines with client delivery expectations
* Reporting — Participate in weekly performance reviews; track personal KPIs including submittals, interviews, and placements

**Required Qualifications**

* Equivalent work experience in related feild.
* 0–2 years of recruiting, HR, or staffing industry experience.
* Basic understanding of U.S. work authorizations (H1B, OPT/CPT, GC, USC) and staffing models (C2C, W2, 1099\).
* \[**Required**] Strong verbal and written English communication skills
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).
* High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple open requisitions simultaneously.
* Self\-motivated with a strong work ethic and desire to grow within the staffing industry

**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications**

* Prior experience in U.S. IT staffing or bench sales operations
* Familiarity with sourcing on Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, or CareerBuilder

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary \+ performance\-based incentives
* Structured onboarding and mentorship from senior recruiting leadership
* Hands\-on training in IT contract staffing and U.S. talent acquisition
* Clear growth path into Senior Recruiter, Account Manager, or Team Lead roles
* Collaborative, fast\-paced team environment with national client exposure

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: People Solutions Associate
description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Visa’s People Shared Services team supports more than 20,000 employees globally across multiple locations and geographies and play a critical role in ensuring a best\-in\-class employee experience. The Associate Analyst role will be primarily responsible for processing employee data changes, program support and execution of task, Verification of Employment request, employee file record management and assisting with other queries related to employee data accuracy.

  

Our team partners closely with our Centers of Excellence teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement while guaranteeing an efficient and consistent approach to the execution of our People Shared Service operational goals.


This role reports to the Manager, People Shared Services.


Key areas of responsibility:

* Will assist in supporting global programs/processes such as Timely Termination Processing, HR Privileged Access Assignments, Team Reporting and Audit controls
* Work to analyze and resolve queries for both simple to medium complexity data processing request as it relates to employee transfers, terminations, personal demographic updates, VOE’s and other inquiries from People Managers, Business Partners, employees, internal COE’s and vendors
* Make appropriate adjustments per the request and communicating progress and outcomes to requestors in a timely and efficient manner, utilizing strong customer service skills
* Employs internal tools such as the case management system (ServiceNow), HRIS (Workday) and vendor tools (Smart Recruiters, ADP, Guardian etc.) effectively to research and assess next steps and accurate resolutions
* Supports cyclical HR events that impact employees (i.e., Annual Review/Promotions)
* Updates and improves the knowledge repository to enable team to take ownership of a higher percentage of inbound inquiries. Actively identifies opportunities for educating team.
* Assist in making recommendation related to training documentation and gaps
* Establish and maintain collaborative and respectful partnerships with our COE’s in HR, Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, and others to further our continuous effort to improve operations, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly to provide a high\-quality employee experience
* Be flexible and able to handle unexpected transactions and service requests
* Maintain discretion and adhere to strict confidentiality standards


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**


Basic Qualifications:

* Associate: Minimum of 6 months of work experience or a Bachelor's Degree


Preferred Qualifications:

* Associate: 2 or more years of work experience
* 6\+ years of relevant work experience.
* Must have a High School diploma or equivalent. 4\+ years of relevant work experience.
* Experience using enterprise\-scale HRIS tools (like Workday, PeopleSoft, ADP etc.)
* Experience using a HR Case Management system (like ServiceNow)
* General knowledge of HR functional policies and practices within a Global Shared Services model
* Familiar with the utilization and management of enterprise level systems such as Workday and ServiceNow, other comparable software tools acceptable
* Able to work in a fast paced/high volume environment with a focus on QA and meeting established KPIs/SLAs
* Collaborative style and a good team player with a strong customer centered mind\-set that focusses on employee experience and continuous improvement for all processes
* Strong communicator who can deliver easily understandable resolutions to employees and internal teams in common/natural language
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products (PP Presentations, Excel Pivots, VLOOKUP’s, Power BI etc)
* Able to work Monday – Friday and be available for meetings with teams in the US, APAC, CEMEA \& Europe when required

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Director of Talent Acquisition, APAC
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Director of Talent Acquisition, APAC**

**About the Role**  

The Director of Talent Acquisition, APAC, leads a multi\-country team responsible for end\-to\-end hiring across engineering and manufacturing in Asia Pacific (India, Thailand, Philippines, China, Taiwan). This leader brings regional coherence and operational consistency to the way ADI evaluates and attracts talent, while serving as the primary voice of the APAC talent function to global HR and executive leaders. In addition to managing the full spectrum of hiring activity, this role is tasked with building out university partnerships, supporting the promotions process, and shaping a three\-to\-five year talent strategy for the region. Success means both delivering on hiring goals and elevating the broader workforce strategy across a complex, post\-acquisition environment.


**Key Responsibilities**

* **Regional Talent Leadership** : Direct and coach talent acquisition teams across APAC countries, ensuring operational excellence and unified ways of working.
* **Stakeholder Engagement** : Serve as the primary point of contact for APAC talent to global HR, regional executives, and senior country leadership.
* **Talent Frameworks \& Evaluation** : Drive consistency in how talent is assessed and selected, building frameworks that support business needs and enable mobility.
* **University Partnerships** : Formalize and expand relationships with key higher education institutions to build long\-term hiring pipelines.
* **Strategic Workforce Planning** : Partner with APAC business and HR leaders to develop and implement a three\-to\-five\-year regional talent strategy.
* **Promotions Process \& Talent Programs** : Collaborate on the design and delivery of promotions, talent review, and workforce programs.
* **Cross\-Cultural Integration** : Foster collaboration and shared standards in a region shaped by acquisitions and diverse legacy cultures.
* **Operational Excellence** : Land global TA standards locally, ensuring managers experience a common ADI approach to hiring across all APAC countries.

**Must Have Skills**

* **Multi\-country Team Leadership** : Demonstrated experience leading and developing high\-performing TA teams spanning multiple countries and cultures.
* **Stakeholder Management \& Negotiation** : Skilled in building trust and negotiating with senior leaders across countries and functions.
* **Talent Framework Design** : Track record of designing and deploying scalable talent evaluation and selection frameworks.
* **University/External Partnerships** : Experience formalizing and growing higher\-ed partnerships to support talent pipelines.
* **Collaboration \& Influence** : An effective collaborator who can unify stakeholders and drive alignment in complex, matrixed environments.
* **Change Leadership** : Comfortable leading through ambiguity and integration, especially post\-acquisition.

**Preferred Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and 10\+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience supporting both engineering and manufacturing talent needs is a plus.
* Familiarity with APAC labor markets and regulatory environments.
* Proven ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce \- Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State \- Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*

Job Req Type: Experienced  

Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time  

Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

 Scale100x.ai: We are the world’s first AI\-powered growth accelerator helping consumer brands scale through partner\-led expansion. Founded by IIT Bombay alumni and serial entrepreneurs behind Expertrons, the team has built and exited ventures to public\-listed companies and scaled 300\+ franchise networks across sectors. We support high\-potential brands by building 100\+ outlets or partners annually, leveraging AI\-driven sales, marketing, and operational execution, driving profitability through data\-led processes, assisting with fundraising, investor relations, and IPO preparedness, and providing a proprietary AI\-based scalability score to guide long\-term growth. In the last year, we’ve driven growth across EV, F\&B, Retail, Salon, EdTech, Play Areas, and more\- including enabling a partner brand to raise $5\.4M in Series A. We are now expanding our team to build the next generation of high\-growth consumer brands in India and globally. If you want to work at the intersection of AI, growth, franchising, and venture building, Scale100x.ai is the place to be.
   

  

 This internship is a career\-launchpad for individuals who want to build a strong foundation in talent acquisition. You will gain end\-to\-end exposure to sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordination, and hiring strategy while working closely with senior HR leaders. We are looking for highly motivated MBA freshers and fresh graduates who wish to kickstart their career in the talent acquisition domain with structured learning, strong mentorship, and a clear path toward career advancement. After 6 months, a pre\-placement offer (PPO) will be extended based on consistent performance, ownership, and onboarding numbers.
   

  

**Selected Intern's Day\-to\-day Responsibilities Include**
* Talent sourcing \& pipeline development:

* Months 3–4: Taking steady ownership: You manage multiple roles comfortably, maintain consistent communication with selected candidates, and help ensure smooth, timely onboardings.
* Months 5–6: Full flow \& PPO evaluation: You handle end\-to\-end hiring with confidence, support predictable onboarding cycles, and demonstrate consistency\- leading to your performance\-based PPO.

description:
Operations Manager – U.S. Business Operations

**Company:** Vishram Management Group (VMG)  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat – Work From Office  
**Shift:** Night Shift – U.S. Business Hours  
**Salary:** ₹8–12 LPA, depending on experience  
**Experience:** 7\+ years preferred  
**Industry Preference:** Retail / Supermarket / QSR / Multi\-Location Business

Offered Employee Benefits \& Perks

✅ Paid Annual Leave \& Public Holidays  
✅ Comprehensive Health Insurance  
✅ Company\-Matched SIP Investment Program  
✅ Performance\-Based Incentives \& Career Growth  
✅ Milestone Rewards \& Recognition Programs  
✅ International Career \& Transfer Opportunities  
✅ Professional Learning, Training \& Skill Development

About the Role

Vishram Management Group is shifting its Global backend operations to its Ahmedabad office and is looking for a strong **Operations Manager** to take complete ownership of the India backend operation.

This person will act as the **single point of contact between U.S. leadership and the India team** and will be responsible for ensuring that Accounting, HR, Marketing, and Technology functions operate efficiently, meet deadlines, and support the performance of our U.S. businesses.

We are specifically looking for someone with a **retail business management background** who has previously managed business operations beyond store operations—including accounting oversight, HR, marketing, reporting, systems, and team management.

Functions You Will Oversee

You will directly manage and hold accountable:

* **Marketing Center of Excellence**
* **VMG Human Resources**
* **Accounting Teams – VMG, VIS \& VIS LATAM**
* **Technology / IT Manager**
* **Backend Business Operations \& Reporting**

Key ResponsibilitiesBusiness Operations

* Take complete ownership of VMG's Ahmedabad backend operation.
* Act as the primary point of contact for U.S. management.
* Convert management priorities into clear tasks, deadlines, KPIs, and accountability.
* Conduct daily/weekly operational reviews with department managers.
* Identify problems before they reach senior management and drive them to resolution.
* Build SOPs, workflows, reporting systems, and accountability structures.

Accounting \& Financial Oversight

* Oversee accounting teams supporting Vishram group of businesses.
* Review AP, AR, bank reconciliations, cash flow, expenses and management reports.
* Monitor P\&L performance, unusual expenses, overdue receivables and financial discrepancies.
* Ensure accounting information is accurate and delivered to management on time.
* Work with operations to identify cost savings and improve profitability.

HR \& People Management

* Manage the VMG HR Manager and ensure recruitment requirements are completed on time.
* Oversee attendance, productivity, performance management, onboarding and employee accountability.
* Ensure department managers are meeting staffing and performance expectations.
* Develop a performance\-driven culture within the India office.

Marketing Center of Excellence

* Oversee the Marketing Manager and marketing team.
* Ensure marketing activities are connected to measurable business results.
* Review campaign execution, social media, digital marketing, promotions and reporting.
* Hold the marketing team accountable for deadlines, KPIs and quality of execution.

Technology \& Systems

* Manage the Technology Manager and ensure reliable support for U.S. operations.
* Oversee business systems, user access, technology issues, automation and process improvements.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive backend work and improve efficiency.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate has worked in **retail, supermarket, QSR, franchise, hospitality retail, or another multi\-location business** and understands how different departments work together to drive profitability.

You should have experience in several of the following areas:

* Multi\-location retail/business operations
* Team and department management
* Accounting and P\&L oversight
* AP/AR and financial reporting
* HR and recruitment management
* Marketing oversight
* Business technology and systems
* SOP and workflow development
* KPI and performance management
* Cost control and profitability improvement

**This is not a coordinator or administrative position.**

We need a **hands\-on business operator** who can independently manage multiple departments, challenge managers when performance is below expectations, solve problems, and provide U.S. leadership with one clear point of accountability.

Success in This Role

You will be successful when:

* U.S. leadership does not need to follow up with multiple India departments.
* Accounting and management reports are accurate and on time.
* HR positions are filled and employee issues are handled promptly.
* Marketing projects are executed on schedule and measured against results.
* Technology issues are resolved quickly.
* Department managers are held accountable to KPIs.
* Processes become more organized, automated and scalable.
* The Ahmedabad office operates as a true **backend operations center for VMG's Global businesses.**

title: Software Engineer I (Bangalore, India)
description:
**About AiPrise**
 AiPrise is a global compliance orchestration platform helping fintechs, marketplaces, and payment companies verify and onboard customers worldwide. We integrate with 80\+ identity and compliance vendors to deliver a holistic view of risk. We're now building AI\-powered compliance agents to revolutionize KYB, AML, sanctions screening, and risk scoring — enabling our customers to onboard faster, reduce manual reviews, and prevent financial crime.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We’re hiring a Software Engineer I to help build and scale the core platform behind AiPrise’s compliance orchestration and AI agent systems.
   

  

 This is a build it, ship it, own it role. You’ll take features end to end, from design to code to deploy to iterate, across our case management product, vendor integrations, orchestration APIs, and customer facing tools. You’ll be in the trenches with founders and a fast moving team, turning messy real world compliance problems into clean, reliable systems. If you’re a hungry engineer who wants real ownership, high impact, and a product that gets used in production every day, you’ll love this.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Build \& Own Features End\-to\-End**
* Design, develop, and ship production features across our platform stack (backend APIs, data pipelines, integrations, case management UI)
* Own complete features from requirements gathering → implementation → deployment → monitoring
* Build scalable REST APIs and microservices that orchestrate checks across 80\+ compliance vendors (identity verification, sanctions screening, document analysis)
* Develop case management workflows and business logic for KYB/AML compliance processes
* Create data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and routing compliance data at scale
* Integrate with third\-party identity/compliance APIs and handle complex vendor response mapping


**Drive Technical Excellence**
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code with comprehensive documentation
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices
* Debug production issues with urgency; own incident resolution end\-to\-end
* Optimize system performance, reliability, and cost\-efficiency
* Build monitoring, alerting, and observability into your features


**Collaborate**
* Work cross\-functionally with product managers, compliance experts, and customer success teams
* Contribute to technical decision\-making and architecture discussions
* Help shape engineering culture and development workflows as the team scales


**Must\-Have**
**What We're Looking For**
* 0\-2 years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems
* Strong programming fundamentals in at least one modern backend language (Python, Go, Java, Node.js, or similar)
* Experience building RESTful APIs, microservices, or distributed systems
* Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data modeling
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and modern deployment practices
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills; comfortable working in unfamiliar codebases
* Excellent communication skills and ability to translate business needs into technical solutions


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience in FinTech, RegTech, payments, or fraud/risk detection domains
* Knowledge of compliance workflows (KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, adverse media)
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS)
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB) or search engines (Elasticsearch)
* Experience integrating with third\-party APIs and managing vendor relationships at scale
* Frontend development experience (React, TypeScript) for building internal tools
* Background working with ML/AI systems or data\-intensive applications
* Kubernetes, Terraform, or infrastructure\-as\-code experience


**Why AiPrise**
* Build mission\-critical software that directly fights financial crime and fraud for companies like Meta and leading fintechs
* Work with diverse, complex datasets from 200\+ countries
* Join a fast\-moving YC\-backed startup where your work has immediate customer impact
* Ship quickly — your code will reach production in days, not months
* Collaborate in\-person with a talented, mission\-driven team in San Jose
* Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside

description:
Overview of 66degrees
   

  

 66degrees is an end\-to\-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
   

  

 At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
   

  

 Overview of Role
   

  

 66degrees is seeking a detail\-oriented and motivated QA Engineer with 3–7 years of relevant experience to join our innovation team of product development. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of modern cloud\-native applications. You will build and execute comprehensive test strategies across UI and API layers while collaborating with cross\-functional teams in an agile environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Translate product requirements, user stories, and technical specifications into scalable and maintainable test strategies, test plans, and test cases.
* Design and execute functional, regression, integration, end\-to\-end, and exploratory testing across web and API layers.
* Develop and maintain automation frameworks and test scripts using tools like Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, and Cucumber.
* Validate APIs and microservices using tools like Postman, REST Assured, and Newman.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Developers, and UX teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, stand\-ups, demos, and retrospectives.
* Drive shift\-left testing practices by contributing early in requirement reviews, design discussions, and risk assessments.
* Log, track, prioritize, and validate defects while ensuring timely resolution in collaboration with engineering teams.
* Ensure end\-to\-end traceability between product requirements, test cases, defects, and releases using tools like JIRA, Zephyr, or TestRail.
* Integrate and maintain automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or GitLab CI to support continuous delivery.
* Contribute to improving product quality metrics, release readiness, and overall QA best practices.


**Qualifications**
* 4–7 years of experience in manual and automation testing for product\-based web and API applications.
* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum practices, and quality engineering principles.
* Hands\-on experience with Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Appium, and Cucumber (BDD).
* Strong programming/scripting skills using Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* Experience with REST API testing using Postman and REST Assured.
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, backend testing, SQL, and database validation.
* Experience building scalable automation frameworks and maintaining automation suites.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and release validation processes.
* Hands\-on experience with Git, Jenkins, Maven, or similar DevOps/tooling ecosystems.
* Exposure to cloud\-native environments such as GCP (preferred), AWS, or Azure.
* Experience working in fast\-paced product engineering environments with frequent release cycles.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or k6\.
* Exposure to containerized environments and orchestration platforms like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with cross\-browser and cross\-device testing platforms such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs.
* Understanding of observability, monitoring, and production quality validation practices.
* Familiarity with modern quality engineering practices including shift\-left testing and test automation strategy.


 Soft Skills \& Cultural Fit
   

  

* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across engineering and product teams.
* Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive quality initiatives.
* Passion for continuous improvement, automation, and product quality excellence.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced product development environment with evolving priorities.
* Embodies 66degrees' core values: Innovation, Inclusion, Ownership, and Impact.


***Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.***

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Chumley is an early\-stage tech startup building software that gives tradespeople the flexibility and tools they need to focus on their work, streamlining workflows and keeping more engineers operating at optimum levels. The team is small, ambitious, and focused on shipping practical, high\-impact tools used in the field every day.
 



  





 Chumley is looking for a Frontend Developer to own our public web presence end\-to\-end. You will design and build chumley.com, the first thing every customer, engineer, and investor sees, and you will own it from the first wireframe through to what ships. This is a hands\-on role with unusual breadth: you will move between design, frontend, light backend, and the content systems that keep it all running, and you will see your work in front of real users within weeks rather than quarters.
 



  





 What you'll be doing
 


* Designing and building chumley.com from the ground up, taking pages from rough concept through design to production.
* Building fast, accessible, responsive interfaces in React, TypeScript, and Next.js that hold up on a phone in a van as well as on a desktop.
* Owning the visual and interaction design of the site, working in Figma and turning your own work into code.
* Setting up and maintaining a CMS so non\-engineers across the team can update content without needing a developer.
* Handling the light backend work the site needs, including forms, integrations, API routes, analytics, and deployment.
* Making the site perform, covering page speed, Core Web Vitals, SEO fundamentals, and conversion.
* Working directly with the founder to translate what Chumley does into a site that actually explains it.
* Growing into product frontend work over time as the site matures and ChumleyOS expands.



  





 What we're looking for
 


* 3–5 years building production web frontends, with strong React and TypeScript.
* Solid Next.js experience, including routing, server\-side rendering, and data fetching.
* Real design ability. You can take a blank page and a vague brief and produce something that looks considered, not just functional.
* Genuine CSS skill covering layout, responsive design, and modern tooling.
* Comfort reaching into the backend when the work needs it, whether that is API routes, a database, or a deployment pipeline.
* Experience with a headless CMS such as Sanity, Contentful, Payload, or similar.
* A working understanding of web accessibility, built in from the start rather than retrofitted.
* Clear written communication. In a remote team this matters as much as your code.
* Comfort working in a small, fast\-moving startup, taking ownership from idea to deployment.



  





 Nice to have
 


* Experience with a second framework ecosystem such as Vue or Nuxt, and a view on the trade\-offs between approaches.
* Marketing site or brand work where you were measured on conversion, not just delivery.
* Animation and interaction design.
* SEO experience on a site you took from zero.
* Testing experience with tools such as Playwright, Vitest, or Testing Library.
* Previous work on tools for trades, field services, logistics, or other operations\-heavy environments.
* A portfolio, GitHub, or side projects we can look at.



  





 What you'll get
 


* Full ownership of Chumley's public face, with your name on the work rather than a ticket queue.
* The chance to set the design language, frontend architecture, and tooling from scratch at an early\-stage startup.
* Close collaboration with the founder and a small, senior team, with direct impact on roadmap and priorities.
* A clear path into product engineering as ChumleyOS grows.
* Fully remote, wherever you are. We do not require a specific timezone and we work async by default.



  





 If you like owning things end\-to\-end, care about how the work looks as well as how it functions, and want to build for an industry that has been badly served by software, Chumley's Frontend Developer role could be a great fit.
 



  





 Chumley is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are happy to make adjustments to our process on request.

* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

* Ensure compliance with company standards and safety requirements.
* Maintain inventory control and replacement schedules.

* Coordinate with service providers.
* Ensure compliance with hygiene and quality standards.
* Conduct periodic inspections and audits.

* Prepare annual administration and facility management budgets.
* Track monthly expenditures against approved budgets.
* Identify and implement cost\-saving initiatives.
* Negotiate contracts and service agreements to achieve operational efficiency.

12\. Vendor \& Contract Management


* Manage administration\-related vendors and service providers.
* Develop service agreements, SLAs, and performance metrics.
* Conduct quarterly vendor performance reviews.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and company policies.

13\. MIS, Reporting \& Documentation


* Prepare weekly and monthly MIS reports.
* Analyze operational performance and cost trends.
* Maintain records related to administration, contracts, compliance, and audits.
* Support management reviews with data\-driven insights.

14\. Cross Functional Coordination


* Work closely with:

	+ Finance
	+ HR
	+ Procurement
	+ EHS
	+ Corporate Administration
* Support plant expansion projects and infrastructure initiatives.
* Participate in continuous improvement programs.

**Experience**

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in Administration, Facilities Management, and Plant Administration.
* Experience in handling administration functions for a manufacturing facility with 500\+ employees.
* Proven experience as an individual contributor managing end\-to\-end administrative operations.
* Exposure to multinational/global work environments is mandatory.
* Experience in manufacturing, engineering, industrial, or facility management organizations preferred.

**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA, B.Tech, or equivalent professional qualification will be an added advantage.
* Candidates from Facility Management organizations such as JLL, CBRE, Cushman \& Wakefield, ISS, etc., will be preferred.

description:

**Job Number**

**Job Summary**
 The Director of Human Resources will report directly to the property General Manager, with a dotted\-line (functional) reporting relationship to the Regional Senior Director of Human Resources and will be an integral member of the property executive committee. As a member of the Human Resources organization, he/she contributes a high level of human resource generalist knowledge and expertise for a designated property. He/she will be accountable for talent acquisition, succession/workforce planning, performance management and development for property employees, using technology efficiently, and coaching/developing others to help influence and execute business objectives in the most efficient manner. He/she generally works with considerable independence, developing processes to accomplish objectives in alignment with broader business objectives. Additionally, he/she utilizes a Human Resource Business Plan aligned with property and brand strategies to deliver HR services that enable business success.
   

  

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
**Education And Experience**
* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


 OR
   

  

* 4\-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**
**Managing the Human Resources Strategy**
* Executes and follows\-up on engagement survey related activities.
* Champions and builds the talent management ranks in support of property and region diversity strategy.
* Translates business priorities into property Human Resources strategies, plans and actions
* Implements and sustains Human Resources initiatives at the property.
* Coordinates the human capital review process at property(s) and leads succession planning activities on property and in the market, as appropriate.
* Leads the assessment of property(s) leadership pipeline through the human capital review process and assists with follow\-up.
* Creates value through proactive approaches that will affect performance outcome or control cost.
* Monitors effective use of myHR by property managers and employees.
* Leads and participates in succession management and workforce planning.
* Responsible for Human Resources strategy and execution.
* Serves as key change manager for initiatives that have high employee impact.
* Attends owners meetings as a member of the property executive committee and provides meaning or context to the Human Resources results (e.g., retention statistics, critical open positions, employee satisfaction, and training initiatives and results); and demonstrates an understanding of owner priorities.
* Supervises one or more on\-property Human Resources, as well as market\-based Human Resources Specialist type resources where appropriate.


**Managing Staffing and Recruitment Process**
* Analyzes open positions to balance the development of existing talent and business needs.
* Serves as coach and expert facilitator of the selection and interviewing process.
* Surfaces opportunities in work processes and staffing optimization.
* Makes staffing decisions to manage the talent cadre and pipeline at the property.
* Develops staffing strategy (in collaboration with hiring manager) relating to hiring practices; consults with hiring manager on compensation, benefits, etc.
* Monitors sourcing process and outcomes of staffing process.
* Ensures managers are competent in assessing and evaluating hourly staff.


**Managing Employee Compensation Strategy**
* Remains current and knowledgeable in the internal and external compensation and work competitive environments.
* Leads the planning of the hourly employee total compensation strategy.
* Champions the communication and proper use of total compensation systems, tools, programs, policies, etc.
* Participates in quarterly internal equity analysis; reviews internal equity reports and surface issues needing resolution.
* Creates and implement s total compensation management packages/offers, particularly recognition and incentive programs directed towards property priorities.


**Managing Staff Development Activities**
* Ensures completion of the duties and responsibilities of the properties’ Human Resources staff members, as outlined in applicable job description(s).
* Ensures property Human Resources staff is properly trained in all employee\-related human resource information to appropriately respond to property employees.
* Serves as resource to property Human Resources staff on employee relations questions and issues.
* Continually reinforces positive employee relations concepts.

* Maintain accurate and updated employee records and HR documentation.
* Prepare and coordinate payroll inputs and employee\-related data.
* Support PF, ESIC, gratuity, and other statutory compliance documentation and filings.
* Maintain employment contracts, HR forms, and other employee documentation.
* Ensure timely completion of HR operational and compliance\-related paperwork.

**5\. General Administration**

title: Senior HR Executive
description:
Senior HR – Human Resources \& Talent Management

**Location:** Ranchi, Jharkhand  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** On\-site  
**Experience:** 2\+ Years Preferred

We are looking for a **Senior HR professional** who can do much more than recruitment, attendance and payroll.

We need someone who can help us **find the right people, build a strong team, create accountability and develop a high\-performance work culture.**

As we grow, your responsibility will be simple:

**Get the right people in. Develop them. Retain the best. And build systems that allow the organization to scale.**

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Manage the complete hiring process from **manpower planning to onboarding**
* Understand each department's actual talent requirements before starting recruitment
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, referrals and other channels
* Conduct structured interviews and candidate assessments
* Coordinate technical/departmental interview rounds
* Handle salary negotiations and offer rollouts
* Develop a strong talent pipeline for future requirements
* Improve **quality of hire**, not simply number of hires

We don't want HR to say:

**“Sir, 30 CV aa gaye hain.”**

We want HR to say:

**“I interviewed 12 candidates, shortlisted 3, and here's why these 3 fit the role.”**

2\. Performance Management

Build a performance\-driven system where every employee understands:

**What am I responsible for?**  
**How will my performance be measured?**  
**Where am I currently performing?**  
**What do I need to improve?**

Responsibilities include:

* Defining KRAs \& KPIs with department heads
* Performance reviews
* Probation evaluations
* Employee scorecards
* Performance Improvement Plans (PIP)
* Promotions and increments
* Identifying high performers and underperformers
* Creating accountability across teams

3\. Employee Development

We don't want employees doing the same job the same way for five years.

HR should help people **continuously improve.**

* Identify skill gaps
* Develop training programs
* Coordinate internal/external training
* Build leadership capabilities
* Develop future managers
* Create career\-growth paths
* Conduct regular feedback sessions

4\. Culture \& Employee Engagement

Help us build a workplace where people are:

**Ambitious. Accountable. Professional. Curious. And hungry to grow.**

Responsibilities include:

* Employee engagement
* Recognition and reward programs
* Team\-building initiatives
* Conflict resolution
* Employee feedback
* Improving communication between management and employees
* Building ownership and accountability
* Maintaining professional workplace standards

5\. HR Policies \& Systems

Create and maintain scalable HR processes for:

* Attendance
* Leave
* Working hours
* Onboarding
* Probation
* Confirmation
* Performance reviews
* Promotions
* Compensation
* Employee exits
* Full \& final settlement
* HR documentation

The objective is to make HR **system\-driven rather than person\-dependent.**

6\. HR Operations \& Compliance

* Maintain employee records and documentation
* Coordinate payroll and salary\-related information
* Maintain offer letters, appointment letters and employee files
* Manage attendance and leave records
* Handle onboarding and exit formalities
* Coordinate statutory HR compliance applicable to the organization
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information

7\. Retention \& Employee Relations

Hiring good people is difficult.

**Losing good people because nobody understood why they were leaving is worse.**

The Senior HR should:

* Conduct regular employee check\-ins
* Identify retention risks
* Conduct exit interviews
* Understand reasons behind attrition
* Resolve workplace concerns professionally
* Recommend retention strategies to management

8\. Management Partnership

This is a **Senior HR role**, not simply an administrative HR position.

You should be comfortable working directly with management on:

* Workforce planning
* Organizational structure
* Hiring priorities
* Salary benchmarking
* Performance issues
* Promotions
* Leadership development
* Employee retention
* Culture
* HR budgeting
* Future manpower requirements

You should be capable of challenging management respectfully when you believe a **people decision could hurt the organization.**

Qualification

Preferred:

**MBA / PGDM in HR**  
or  
**Master's/Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Management or related field**

Professional HR certifications will be an added advantage.

However, **practical HR leadership experience and demonstrated results will carry significant weight.**

Experience

**5\+ years of HR experience preferred**, with meaningful exposure to:

* Recruitment
* Performance management
* Employee relations
* HR operations
* Policies \& compliance
* Team building
* Talent development

Previous experience building or improving HR systems in a **growing company** will be highly valued.

Who We're Looking For

We want someone who combines:

**People Skills \+ Business Understanding \+ Discipline \+ Empathy \+ Data \+ Leadership**

Someone who can have a friendly conversation with an employee in the morning and conduct a difficult performance conversation professionally in the afternoon.

Someone who understands that HR's responsibility isn't simply to keep employees happy.

It's to create an environment where **good people can perform exceptionally well and the organization can grow.**

How to Apply

Please send:

* Updated CV
* Current location
* Current/Last organization
* Total HR experience
* Current/Last salary
* Expected salary
* Notice period
* One example of an HR system/process you personally built or significantly improved

**Work Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand**

What Success Looks Like in This Role

After joining, we should gradually see:

**Better Hiring → Better Onboarding → Clearer Accountability → Better Performance → Stronger Managers → Lower Unwanted Attrition → Stronger Culture**

We are looking for someone who can help us **build the organization, not simply run the HR department.**

title: HR Coordinator

Responsibilities will include:

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Preferred Experience

* HR Consulting

* Retail HR
* Employee Engagement
* Recruitment \& Onboarding
* SOP Implementation
* Performance Management

* Store/Business Operations

What We Are Looking For

This is **not a purely desk\-based HR position**.

We are looking for someone who can:

**Understand → Coordinate → Implement → Follow Up → Report → Escalate**

The candidate should have the maturity to represent FFC professionally at the client location and work effectively with both management and employees.

Key Competencies

* Communication Skills
* Stakeholder Management
* Follow\-up \& Execution
* Problem Solving

Performance Measures

The role will be evaluated on:

description:

For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


Rippling is looking for an Employee Relations Business Partner based in Bangalore, India to join its HR Policy \& Compliance Team to manage employee relations investigations.

* Leverage data, AI, and automation to improve employee relations processes, scale case handling, and create better experiences for employees and managers.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 5\+ years of experience in employee relations, HR business partnership, HR compliance, workplace investigations, or a related HR role.

* Strong interviewing, fact\-gathering, documentation, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Practical business judgment and strong HR instincts, with the ability to recommend solutions that are fair, consistent, risk\-aware, and operationally realistic.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple matters at once, prioritize urgent issues, and drive work to timely resolution.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with HRBPs, Legal, managers, executives, and other internal stakeholders.
* Ability to use data and case trends to identify recurring issues, improve processes, and support broader employee relations priorities.

description:
**Job Description**
 Job Description
   

  

**About Us**
 Masco Home Products India (MHPI) is a fully owned subsidiary of Masco Corporation, headquartered in Livonia,

 desire for excellence in its people, business solutions, execution, and partnerships with internal customers to

 Headquartered in Livonia, Michigan, Masco Corporation is a global leader in the design, manufacture and
   

  

 distribution of branded home improvement and building products. Our portfolio of industry\-leading brands
   

  

 includes Behr® paint; Delta® and Hansgrohe® faucets, bath and shower fixtures; Liberty® branded decorative and
   

  

 functional hardware; and HotSpring® spas. We leverage our powerful brands across product categories, sales
   

  

 channels and geographies to create value for our customers and shareholders.
   

  

 For more information about Masco Corporation, please visit:
   

  

 Masco Corporation, www.masco.com
   

  

 Masco Home Products India (MHPI) MHPI (Masco Home Products India) \| LinkedIn
   

  

 Position Details
   

  

 BI Developer – MHPI
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The BI Developer builds and operates the enterprise dashboards, semantic models, and reporting assets that make
   

  

 Masco's POS and adjacent commercial data usable to the business. This role delivers to the standards and direction
   

  

 set by the BI Delivery Leader and consumes the governed data foundation built by the Data Engineering team. The BI
   

  

 Developer contributes across the full BI lifecycle, including requirements confirmation, semantic modeling,
   

  

 dashboard build, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

 Dashboard \& Report Development
   

  

* Build and maintain enterprise dashboards and reports on Power BI using governed enterprise data.
* Deliver end\-to\-end reporting solutions including requirements confirmation, data sourcing, cleansing,


 normalization, and reporting.
   

  

* Develop, automate, and run user\-friendly dashboards and reports.
* Handle report operations, refresh, and defect resolution for the enterprise BI layer.


 Semantic Modeling \& Metric Development
   

  

* Build and improve Microsoft Tabular semantic models and metric definitions to support reporting requirements.
* Implement enrichment metric calculations and segment classifications feeding the central dashboards.
* Assist with logical and physical data modeling to support business initiatives, in partnership with Data Engineers.
* Apply consistency and quality checks to metrics and semantic models before release.


 Data Quality, Testing \& Support
   

  

* Ensure data accuracy and integrity in dashboards and reports through disciplined testing and validation.
* Monitor automated ETL and BI processes for success and failures.
* Conduct root cause analysis to resolve dashboard, model, and data delivery issues.
* Provide general technical support and troubleshooting to BI end users.


 Collaboration \& Enablement
   

  

* Collaborate with end users to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management and delivery.
* Partner with the Data Engineering team on shared pipelines, models, and metric definitions.
* Partner with fellow BI Developers on modeling standards and metric definitions.
* Provide training and support to end users on BI tools, dashboards, and reports.


 Documentation \& Knowledge Management
   

  

* Document dashboard purpose, metric definitions, data sources, and refresh dependencies as part of the


 definition of done.
   

  

* Follow the documentation standards established by the BI Delivery Leader and Enterprise Data Architect.
* Contribute dashboard and semantic model metadata to the enterprise catalog.


**Required Qualifications**
 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related


 field; equivalent professional experience considered.
   

  

* Proven experience as a BI Developer, BI Analyst, or similar role, with demonstrated delivery of enterprise BI


 solutions.
   

  

* Experience delivering end\-to\-end reporting solutions from requirements through production support.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Advanced hands\-on expertise with Power BI, including Tabular models, DAX, and semantic modeling.
* Strong understanding of the medallion architecture (bronze / silver / gold) and how BI consumes governed


 enterprise data.
   

  

* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and how it fits alongside Power BI in a modern enterprise BI platform.
* Advanced SQL / T\-SQL (queries, stored procedures, functions, DDL, DML) for data wrangling and reporting on


 large volumes of data.
   

  

* Working knowledge of ETL/ELT patterns (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, SSIS or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of the Azure data stack as it supports the BI layer.
* Strong proficiency with data modeling, including ERDs, workflow diagrams, and dimensional (Kimball) modeling.
* Working knowledge of data constructs including data types, normalization, data quality analysis, and efficient BI


 modeling.
   

  

* Understanding of data governance, security, and access as they apply to enterprise BI and certified data sources.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Detail\-oriented and thorough. Ambitious and self\-motivated with strong attention to accuracy.
* Highly self\-motivated and self\-directed. Operates with minimal oversight on complex, hands\-on BI work.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communicator.
* Willingness to explore and understand new and modern BI and analytics tools to add value to the enterprise POS


 and POS\-related analytics space.
   

  

* Collaborative with Data Engineers, fellow BI Developers, and end users.
* Continuous learner who stays current on modern BI and analytics practices.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in retail, consumer goods, or manufacturing analytics environments where POS, sell\-in, inventory,


 and third\-party retail data are core.
   

  

* Understanding of retail metrics (turns, GMROI, margin, category performance).
* Experience with Python, PowerShell, or other scripting languages for data automation.
* Familiarity with Databricks Unity Catalog, data lineage, and observability tools.
* Familiarity with modern DataOps, BIOps, Agile, or Kanban delivery practices.


 Other Mandatory Requirement:
   

  

  Must Have Broadband Availability: Minimum 30 MBPS \- Only connections from national service providers
   

  

 such as Jio, Tata, Airtel, or Hathway Fiber are acceptable. Local or unverified internet providers are not
   

  

 aligned with MHPI IT policy and should not be used for official work.
   

  

  Home Office Setup (Mandatory):
   

  

* working space to accommodate two monitors \+1 laptop (necessary equipment will be provided \+


 additional tools \-role if any).
   

  

* The candidate must have access to a quiet and dedicated home office environment that supports


 productive remote work.
   

  

  IT Asset Arrangement:
   

  

* All necessary equipment (based on role)\- including One/two monitors, one laptop, and supporting


 accessories will be provided by the company. Candidates must ensure safe and secure setup and usage
   

  

 of these assets.
   

  

 This setup is non\-negotiable and essential to ensure uninterrupted workflow, secure data handling, and effective
   

  

 collaboration. Candidates who do not meet this requirement will not be considered.

title: Associate - Power Bi Developer, Data Analytics
description:
**About This Role**
 The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets. This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally, offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset\-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP\-LP solutions. As part of the HPS/BlackRock Transaction, Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson have joined Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick has been appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The IT Data Analytics team is responsible for sourcing, processing data internally and externally. The team covers data needs across all aspects of investment analysis, portfolio management, back\-office processing, investor reporting, and regulatory filings. Data Analytics team members collaborate closely with SMEs across Front Office, Backoffice, Investor Relations, Tax, Legal, Management Company in delivering data reporting and analytics technology solutions.
   

  

 PFS is seeking an Associate, IT Data Analytics to join the firm’s technology organization in Mumbai. This role is primarily business‑focused , with responsibility for partnering closely with investment, operations, and finance teams to deliver analytics, reporting, and AI‑enabled insights supporting HPS’s Public \& Private Credit, CLO, and Long/Short Credit investment platforms.
   

  

 The Associate will act as a bridge between business users and technical teams, helping translate business needs into analytics solutions while developing a strong understanding of data, BI, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
 Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:
   

  

* Work directly with Portfolio Management, Operations, Finance, Risk, and Investor Relations teams to understand business processes and analytics needs.
* Identify reporting gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for


 automation or analytics improvement.
   

  

* Capture business requirements and translate them into clear functional and reporting specifications.
* Help identify opportunities where AI‑enabled analytics could improve


 reporting, insights, or decision‑making.
   

  

* Support adoption of AI‑driven analytics by working with technical teams and business users.
* Develop familiarity with how AI outputs can be consumed in dashboards and reports.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* 5\+ years of total relevant experience with at least 2\+ years of relevant


 experience in the financial industry; hedge fund, private debt fund
   

  

* Strong ability to work with business stakeholders and translate needs into


 analytics solutions.
   

  

* Good knowledge of SQL and BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
* Exposure to data platforms (Azure, Snowflake, or similar) is a plus.
* Experience with Power BI or a comparable platform like Tableau/Qlikview.
* Interest or exposure to AI‑enabled analytics and automation is a strong plus.
* Product knowledge with one or more asset classes (Bank Loans, bonds, credit derivatives, FX forwards) is a plus
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities and inter\-personal skills
* Highest degree of business ethics and professionalism
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field coupled with an MBA from a tier I (IIT / NIT / BITS / equivalent) or (IIM / ISB / XLRI / equivalent) is preferred.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
 At
 **Sovos** 
 , we're powering global tax compliance for half of the Fortune 500 and thousands of businesses worldwide \- processing billions of transactions across 19,000\+ tax jurisdictions. As a
 **Site Reliability Engineer** 
 , you'll be at the core of our infrastructure, designing, scaling, and optimizing the systems that keep our platform running seamlessly.
   

  

 This role blends technical expertise with serving our customers’ needs. You'll implement scalable solutions, drive automation, and respond to monitors and alerts. If you thrive in fast\-paced environments, love solving complex infrastructure challenges, and are passionate about collaborating with others, this is your opportunity to make a global impact.
   

  

**More Specifically, You Will**

* Manage virtual machines and infrastructure using Terraform
* Manage CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for seamless deployments
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, and alerting to drive operational efficiency


**Operational Excellence**
* Ensure high availability and performance of production systems
* Troubleshoot deployment issues and contribute to root cause analysis
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for configuration, release, and deployment processes


**What We Need From You**
* 2\-3 years of experience in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering
* Standard hours aligned with US Business hours with additional On\-call rotation availability to support production systems
* Demonstrated experience operating and maintaining on\-premise datacenter infrastructure (physical or virtualized servers, OS, networking, middleware) is required. The majority of platform operations are datacenter\-based, with cloud serving a supporting role.
* Experience in Azure DevOps, Kubernetes/Docker Swarm, Terraform, and CI/CD pipeline design
* Familiarity with the Grafana LGTM stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir/Prometheus) and the role each plays in a unified observability strategy.
* Experience authoring and managing Grafana alert rules, contact points, and notification policies, including tuning for low noise in high\-cardinality environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in regulated environments (tax, finance, compliance)
* Familiarity with financial systems
* Prior experience embedded within DevOps teams

* Primary office location: India \- Remote
* Opportunity to work with a global organization and gain international exposure

* Mentoring Programs and career development opportunities
* Globally recognized Training and Development programs
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage
* Collaborative work environment with modern tools and technologies
* Opportunity to be part of a growing team and shape its journey

 Stage 1: CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) and EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
   

  

 Stage 2: Automated Video Interview

 Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
   

  

**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose\-built for always\-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT\-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud\-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.
   

  

 More than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

description:
### **Job Information**

### **Job Description**


**PN:** Please read the requirements carefully. Taking the pre\-screening assessment (on the job posting on our website — if your job portal isn't showing it) is mandatory to be considered. **Please do not apply if you are looking for remote / WFH, or are not willing to be deputed at client sites across India for extended periods (6–12 months or longer).**

### **Visiting Agronomist**

#### **Job Description**

  

City Greens is a fast\-growing AgriTech startup building automation and AI\-driven solutions for Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA). We work with modern farms, growers, and institutions to help them improve productivity, efficiency, and sustainability through technology.

  

We are looking for a Visiting Agronomist to be the on\-ground technical backbone of our client farms. You will be on the **CityGreens payroll and deputed at a client site**, owning crop performance day to day, backed by our senior agronomy team.

  

This is a career\-building, pan\-India role. Each deputation typically runs **6 to 12 months or longer**, and over the next 2–5 years you will gain exposure to different technologies, crops, and client sites across the country.

  

You will begin with a **4 to 8 week training program at our AgriTech facility in Ahmedabad**, on CityGreens' crops, systems, and protocols, before your first deputation.

  

As a Visiting Agronomist, you will:

  

* Look after crop health and agronomy day to day at your deputed client farm
* Conduct crop health assessments, troubleshooting, and intervention planning
* Execute the crop plan and agronomy protocols set by the CityGreens senior team, and escalate technical decisions to them
* Train and upskill client farm teams on CEA crop management best practices
* Feed field learnings back into CityGreens' internal agronomy and tech systems
* Work with farm management software, IoT/sensor data, and yield/input tracking

### **Requirements**

* **Minimum 1 year of hands\-on agronomy experience in the field**
* Working knowledge of one or more of: protected cultivation (polyhouse/greenhouse), hydroponics or aeroponics, high\-value horticulture
* Diagnostic ability — identifying and resolving crop health, nutrition, and environmental issues in controlled\-environment settings
* Comfortable working with data — farm management software, IoT/sensor outputs, yield and input tracking
* **Willingness to be deputed and relocate to client sites across India for extended periods (6–12 months or longer) — non\-negotiable**
* Willing to attend the initial 4–8 week training in Ahmedabad

### **Benefits**

* **Salary by experience band:**
	+ 1 year\+ : ₹30,000 – ₹35,000/month
	+ 2 years\+ : ₹35,000 – ₹40,000/month
	+ 3 years\+ : ₹40,000 – ₹50,000/month
	+ 4 years\+ : ₹50,000 – ₹60,000/month
	+ 5 years\+ : ₹60,000\+/month
* PF
* Health Insurance coverage
* **Company\-provided accommodation at the deputed client site**
* Structured training and continuous support from CityGreens' senior agronomy team
* Pan\-India exposure to India's most innovative CEA farms, across diverse geographies, crop systems, and technologies
* A high\-impact role in a fast\-growing AgriTech team

title: Corporate Outreach Executive
description:
**NBD / NBD CRR Executive (Corporate Outreach Executive)Job Purpose**

The NBD / NBD CRR Executive is responsible for generating new corporate business opportunities through cold calling, corporate outreach, networking, research, and lead generation activities. The role focuses on identifying potential corporate clients, initiating conversations, generating qualified inquiries, coordinating with prospects, and building a strong pipeline of corporate event opportunities.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and speaking skills, confidence in making outbound calls, and the ability to communicate professionally with corporate decision\-makers.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Corporate Lead Generation**

* Identify and generate new corporate leads through cold calling, online research, references, networking, and outreach activities.
* Build and maintain a database of potential corporate clients and decision\-makers.
* Identify companies that may require corporate events, conferences, annual functions, product launches, employee engagement events, exhibitions, and experiential events.
* Generate qualified corporate inquiries and hand over relevant opportunities to the Client Servicing / Sales team.
* Continuously build and maintain a strong corporate lead pipeline.

**2\. Cold Calling \& Corporate Outreach**

* Make daily outbound calls to prospective corporate clients.
* Introduce Kahani by i2c Events and its event management services professionally.
* Understand the prospect's requirements, event objectives, tentative budget, guest count, and timelines.
* Identify the relevant decision\-maker or point of contact within the organization.
* Create interest and convert cold prospects into meaningful business conversations.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with prospects.

**3\. Corporate Inquiry Generation**

* Generate inquiries for corporate events, conferences, annual functions, product launches, dealer meets, employee engagement events, award functions, brand activations, exhibitions, MICE events, and experiential events.
* Capture complete inquiry details and ensure qualified leads are handed over to the relevant team.

**4\. Prospect Coordination**

* Coordinate with prospective clients after initial outreach.
* Understand their event requirements and business needs.
* Schedule meetings between prospects and the Client Servicing / Sales team.
* Share company profile, portfolio, and relevant event references when required.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the pre\-sales process.

**5\. Lead Follow\-Up \& Conversion Support**

* Conduct regular follow\-ups with active prospects.
* Track responses, requirements, meeting status, and next actions.
* Reconnect with old, inactive, and potential corporate leads.
* Identify opportunities for repeat and annual corporate business.
* Support the team in converting leads into meetings and business opportunities.

**6\. Corporate Database Management**

* Research and maintain an updated database of corporate companies and decision\-makers.
* Maintain accurate records of company name, contact person, designation, contact details, requirements, lead source, follow\-up status, meeting status, and opportunity value.
* Keep CRM and lead trackers updated regularly.

**7\. Market \& Company Research**

* Research potential corporate clients and industries.
* Identify companies with upcoming events, launches, conferences, celebrations, or employee engagement requirements.
* Identify new channels and opportunities for corporate lead generation.
* Track relevant corporate networking and industry opportunities.

**8\. Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with Client Servicing, Sales, Creative, Production, and Operations teams for qualified inquiries.
* Provide complete lead briefs before handing over prospects.
* Ensure all relevant client information is communicated accurately.
* Track the status of handed\-over leads.

**9\. Reporting \& Target Achievement**

* Maintain daily calling and lead generation reports.
* Track calls made, new leads, qualified leads, inquiries, meetings, follow\-ups, and conversions.
* Achieve assigned daily, weekly, and monthly calling and lead generation targets.
* Submit regular performance reports to the reporting manager.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Daily outbound calls
* New corporate contacts added
* Qualified corporate leads generated
* Corporate inquiries generated
* Meetings scheduled
* Lead\-to\-meeting conversion
* Follow\-up completion rate
* Corporate opportunities generated
* Revenue pipeline contribution
* Monthly target achievement

**Communication \& RelationshipsInternal**

* Business Development Team

* Operations Team

**External**

* Corporate Companies

* Marketing Heads
* Corporate Communication Teams
* Procurement Teams
* Event Managers
* Business Owners
* Corporate Decision\-Makers

**Education \& ExperienceEducation**

* Graduate in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Event Management, Commerce, or any related field.

**Experience**

* 0–2 years of experience in Business Development, Telecalling, Inside Sales, Corporate Sales, Lead Generation, Client Servicing, or a similar role.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and confidence in speaking may also apply.

**Skills \& CompetenciesCommunication \& Speaking Skills**

* **Excellent verbal and interpersonal communication skills.**
* **Confident and clear speaking ability for cold calling and client conversations.**
* Ability to communicate professionally with corporate decision\-makers.
* Strong listening and questioning skills.
* Good telephone etiquette.
* Ability to build rapport quickly with prospects.
