title: HR Business Partner - Dehradun
description:
Designation: NA


Location: India Uttarakhand 97 Rajpur Road, Dehradun


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Purpose**


The role is responsible to act as the face of HR at the designated function and provide support on all employee life cycle HR processes in collaboration with key business stakeholders for the employees of the business.

**Key facts:**

* Business growth and expansion have led to the creation of a geographically distributed employee base
* HR presence is seen as a key organizational need in order to
	+ Enhance employee experience and engagement levels
	+ Act as a partner to business
	+ Ensure uniformity of employees’ HR process experience
	+ Identify and flag off potential employee concerns and issues in a timely and proactive manner
	+ Enable a consistent organizational culture
	+ Reduce decision time on employee queries and grievances

**Key Challenges:**

* To manage stakeholder expectations on various HR deliverables such as
	+ Employee Queries on payroll, benefits, and rewards
	+ Recruitment TATs
* To keep abreast with process changes and roll outs by the Corporate teams and ensure uniform coverage within the assigned function
* To identify potential employee risk situations and flag off in a timely manner for necessary action or mitigation
* To provide business relevant employee inputs to leaders while also playing the role of an employee champion
* To drive adherence on HR policies across various geographically spread locations

 **Key Result Areas:**

**Key Result Areas**

 **Supporting Actions**

 **Employee Engagement \&**

**Employee Relations Administration**

  

* Works closely with the business to ensure maximum participation in the employee engagement surveys.
* Evaluates results and identifies post survey actions
* Design programs for areas which need improvement as reflected in engagement scores in conjunction with the Corporate EE team
* Manage employee engagement programs, calendar events, business connects, leadership \& HR connects/ town halls, R\&R and HR communications for the assigned function
* Participates in the design and implementation of various employee relations programs.
* Conducts investigations independently on specific employee issues and brings them to closure in collaboration with relevant stakeholder and by following the appropriate procedures
* Partners with COE and Compliance on sensitive or complex employee situations at the ground level that may have potentially broader risk exposure.
* Works with line managers and employees to address all types of employee relations issues ensuring a balance in representing all parties’ interests
 **Performance Management \&**

**Total Rewards Administration**

  

* Plans, manages and provides support to the Corporate Performance Management Team for the leadership review process and the strategic objectives therein. This includes both annual and mid\-year processes which focus on performance management and talent development
* Provides advice and counsel on performance management issues.
* Partners with business leaders to address performance gaps and facilitates discussions or set up a process to take appropriate action.
* Guides Managers on all aspects of performance management including feedback reviews and performance coaching.
* Assists managers in utilizing Corporate driven rewards programs to motivate and recognize teams for their contribution.
* Partners in the Functional roll out and implementation of the Annual Performance and Pay cycle programs by providing managerial education \& consultation on specific situations and program tool support
* Provides compensation support including salary planning, approval of salary actions, promotions and job re\-leveling
 **Talent Acquisition, on\-boarding \& Induction Operations**

  

* Partners in selection process of lateral hires for Lines of Business by carrying out HR interviews
* Supports the Corporate TA team on Campus Recruitments
* Extends On\-boarding \& induction support for new joiners in conjunction with the Corporate TA team
* Identifies recruitment vendor partners for the Function and supports the sourcing of profiles for Function positions
* Facilitates interview and candidate assessment processes
* Facilitates pre\-joining candidate engagement for prospective hires as per process guidelines
* Manage Induction on new joinees
 **L\&D and Talent Management**

**Operations**

  

* Conducts/ Facilitates specific training interventions related to Communication, HR Process updates, HR policy refreshers, Soft Skills and Team Management etc.
* Partner with managers to retain, develop and motivate people to achieve their fullest potential.
* Partners with business and the Corporate HR team on workforce planning, succession planning, and skills assessment
* Assesses the Line of business’s HR training needs and conducts one on one counseling sessions or facilitates group training sessions as appropriate
* Provides inputs on competencies \& development tools for managers and employees within the Zone.
* Facilitates career management programs at a Zonal level in collaboration with business mangers
* Works with the Corporate Talent Management team to identify Zonal Talent Pool and engage with them on a regular basis through various touch points
* Provides indications of early warning on Talent Pool potential exits and works on mitigating the risk through various employee retention actions in consultation with the Corporate team and Business Managers
 **HR Operations**

  

* Supports effective documentation at the zone of all important personnel documentation such as joining formalities, benefits related inputs, payroll inputs etc in a timely and accurate manner
* Consults with the Corporate Payroll team to clarify employee concerns/ queries related to salaries and benefits administration
* Supports roll out of and awareness building on employee benefits
 **HR Processes \& Policy Compliance**

  

* Implements, administers and interprets \[ when required] corporate policies, programs or procedures
* Ensures adherence to organizational and employee policies
* Builds awareness about policy objectives and procedures
* Supports managers in applying HR policies on moderate to high risk situations.
* Escalates specific situations in a timely manner to Head\- HR for immediate intervention and resolution as appropriate
* Advices on policy revisions and / or creation from a Zonal perspective
 **Stakeholder Management**

  

* Provides ongoing support to the Zone business leaders on human resources related matters, policies and procedures
* Challenges business in specific instances on policy adherence and employee welfare concerns
* Collaborates effectively with external stakeholders such as Labour officers, Auditors, Regulatory Inspectors and vendor partners in keeping with organization guidelines and objectives
 **Employee Feedback \& Exit Management**

  

* Creates forums and facilitate interactions between the employees \& the Zone business leaders on a regular basis
* Gathers informal feedback through relationship building and facilitates grievance management based on insightful feedback
* Manages exit interviews and supports the business in analyzing the data
* Identifies solutions to manage voluntary attrition
 **HR MIS, Audit Requirements \&**

**Reporting**

  

* Provides MIS inputs for key Organization wide HR Dashboards
* Validates Headcount and other critical information metrics against actual representation for the Corporate HR reporting requirements
* Generates analytics of data which can support business decisions (Talent pool lists/ Branch wise employee survey Scorecards/Attrition analysis etc)
* Reviews and analyzes business unit data to identify trends and recommend solutions to improve performance, retention, and employee experience
* Extends all required support to HR audit exercise and takes appropriate action to address observations

title: HR Director (India)
description:
**Our Story**


At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. Alight embraces values that come directly from our people – purposeful, human, united and growth\-minded – reflecting our inclusive culture and promise that our clients expect. We are passionate about connecting purpose with impact. Alight empowers clients to build a healthier and more financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, navigation, and absence management.

**Our Benefits**


With a comprehensive total rewards package, Alight offers programs and plans that support your mind, body, wallet, and life. Benefits include health, starting Day One. Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans, and career growth opportunities – all within a thriving global organization.

**Great Place to Work**


Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards **Click Here.**


We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers.alight.com.

**About the Role**


This is a distinctive opportunity for an HR leader to shape the people agenda for a high\-growth India organization, influence business strategy and build scalable people solutions that support Alight’s next phase of transformation.


The India HR Director will lead the HR Business Partner and Employee Relations functions across Alight’s India operations, supporting leaders and colleagues across Gurgaon, Noida, Chennai, Hyderabad and Kochi. The role is a member of the India HR Leadership Team and reports to the India HR Head.


This highly visible leadership role is responsible for shaping and executing India’s people strategy. The HR Director will serve as a trusted advisor to the India Leadership Team, helping leaders navigate growth, organizational change, workforce complexity and talent priorities while strengthening a high\-performance culture grounded in Alight’s values.


The ideal candidate brings strategic judgment, operational discipline and strong enterprise partnership. They create structure in ambiguity, build scalable governance, identify insights from complex situations and translate strategy into practical execution. Success in this role requires strong business acumen, high emotional intelligence, executive presence and the ability to influence across a global matrix.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Business Partnership**

* Serve as the primary HR partner to the India Leadership Team, ensuring people priorities are directly aligned with business strategy, growth objectives and operational needs.
* Advise leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, succession, talent reviews, leadership effectiveness and change execution.
* Use workforce data, trends and insights to surface risks, identify opportunities and inform leadership decisions.
* Embed Alight’s values, culture and leadership expectations across the India organization.
* Build manager capability across India by equipping people leaders to drive performance, engagement, accountability, communication and colleague support with consistency and confidence.
* Connect people priorities to business outcomes, including operational stability, productivity, ramp readiness, attrition management and leadership capacity.

**HRBP, Employee Relations and Organizational Effectiveness**

* Lead, coach and develop a high\-performing HRBP and Employee Relations team.
* Establish clear operating rhythms, governance mechanisms and accountability across the HRBP and ER functions.
* Build consistent employee relations practices that balance colleague experience, business needs and risk management.
* Ensure effective handling of investigations, employee concerns, disciplinary matters and workplace issues across all locations.
* Lead workforce integration, employee rebadging and organizational transition initiatives, ensuring a seamless colleague experience, continuity of delivery and effective cultural integration.
* Drive consistency in manager practices, people decisions and employee experience across teams and locations.
* Establish proactive risk\-sensing mechanisms to identify engagement concerns, manager capability gaps, attrition risks, cultural hotspots and employee relations patterns before they escalate.
* Lead employee listening, engagement action planning and leader follow\-through across sites, translating colleague feedback into clear, measurable improvements.
* Strengthen cultural integration across legacy and incoming colleague populations by reinforcing one Alight identity, consistent leadership practices and inclusive employee experiences.

**HR Operations, Governance and Global Partnership**

* Design and implement scalable HR processes, operating mechanisms and governance frameworks that support India’s continued growth and complexity.
* Develop meaningful people metrics, dashboards and insights that strengthen accountability and decision\-making.
* Partner with global HR and business leaders to align enterprise priorities with India business needs.
* Advise global stakeholders on India workforce dynamics, labor market trends, regulatory requirements and cultural considerations.
* Build strong partnerships across Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, Talent Management, HR Operations, Legal and Compliance.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, company policies and regulatory requirements across all India locations.
* Translate global policies, programs and standards into practical India\-ready execution, ensuring managers understand expectations and apply policies consistently across teams and locations.
* Maintain visible leadership across India locations through regular leader connects, employee forums, site visits and local issue\-resolution mechanisms.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Brings structure, clarity and momentum through periods of growth, ambiguity and change.
* Builds scalable systems, governance and operating mechanisms that create consistency, predictability and accountability.
* Demonstrates strong business acumen, sound judgment and disciplined execution.
* Identifies patterns, synthesizes complex information and translates insights into practical actions.
* Influences effectively across a complex global matrix and earns credibility with senior leaders.
* Communicates with executive presence, clarity and impact.
* Builds trust through high emotional intelligence, collaboration and partnership.
* Develops strong HRBP and Employee Relations capability while elevating the effectiveness and credibility of the broader HR function.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant HR Business Partner and Employee Relations leadership responsibilities, with at least 5 years leading teams.
* Experience operating within a large, complex, matrixed multinational organization.
* Demonstrated success building scalable HR operating models, governance frameworks and people processes.
* Experience leading workforce transitions, employee rebadging, integrations, acquisitions or other large\-scale organizational transformation initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws, employee relations practices and regulatory requirements.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive business outcomes through people strategies.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and organizational effectiveness capabilities.
* Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Willingness to work from the office five days per week and travel periodically across India locations.

**Application and Interview**


By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight’s employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.


Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera\-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.

At Alight, we welcome and embrace all individuals, regardless of their background, and are dedicated to creating a culture that enables every employee to thrive. Join us in building a brighter, more inclusive future.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
Overview:

SSOE is seeking a full life cycle recruiting and Talent Acquisition Manager role based in Mumbai, India. The position partners with hiring managers, HR leaders, and business leaders to identify, attract, assess, and hire top talent for India\-based openings.  

This role is for a hands\-on leader who will support full life cycle recruitment for assigned requisitions and also serve as a trusted advisor on India talent market trends, workforce planning, compensation expectations, notice\-period norms, candidate engagement, recruitment compliance, and inclusive hiring practices. This position also manages, coaches, and develops a team of recruiters while ensuring recruitment work is delivered with quality, consistency, and efficiency.
AI and Innovation:

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.
Responsibilities:
**Team Leadership and Section Management*** Lead, coach, direct, coordinate, and supervise Talent Acquisition section personnel.
* Manage, coach, and develop recruiters by setting goals, providing feedback, supporting professional growth, and driving accountability.
* Monitor recruitment workload, recruiter assignments, hiring priorities, talent pipelines, and recruiting capacity.
* Identify team strengths, development areas, and training needs; implement training plans with HR, Training and Development, or other appropriate resources.
* Support employee relations activities for section personnel with assistance from Human Resources.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, inclusion, compliance, continuous improvement, and high performance.

**Full Life Cycle Recruiting and Candidate Management*** Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for mid\- to senior\-level India\-based roles, including intake, sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, negotiation, pre\-joining engagement, and onboarding handoff.
* Champion the candidate experience through timely communication, clear expectations, structured feedback, offer transparency, and pre\-joining engagement.
* Communicate compensation, benefits, work model, career development opportunities, company culture, and employee value proposition to candidates accurately.
* Support India\-specific recruitment practices, including notice\-period management, offer acceptance risk, counteroffer risk, joining documentation, and background verification coordination.

**Strategic Talent Advisory and Stakeholder Partnership*** Serve as a strategic talent advisor to hiring managers, HR Managers, and business leaders on workforce planning, talent availability, market intelligence, compensation trends, notice periods, and recruitment best practices.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, role requirements, project staffing demands, critical skills, and hiring priorities.
* Educate hiring managers on recruitment processes, interview discipline, candidate evaluation, inclusive hiring, hiring compliance, salary discussions, notice periods, and offer\-closing strategies.
* Collaborate with HR, Total Rewards, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and business leadership on requisitions, postings, offers, compensation alignment, employer branding, documentation, and recruitment best practices.

**Sourcing Strategy and Talent Pipeline Development*** Develop and execute sourcing strategies using employee referrals, LinkedIn, job portals, professional networks, social media, diversity channels, campus partnerships, and recruitment vendors.
* Build relationships with colleges, universities, technical institutes, professional associations, industry networks, vocational schools, and community organizations.
* Represent the company at job fairs, campus events, professional networking events, industry forums, and talent branding initiatives in India.
* Manage external search firms, staffing partners, job boards, campus partners, and recruitment vendors; evaluate vendor quality, timelines, and cost\-effectiveness.

**India Recruitment Standards and Compliance*** Ensure recruiting processes align with fair, consistent, merit\-based, and inclusive hiring practices.
* Apply structured interviews and consistent candidate evaluation criteria.
* Maintain accurate requisition tracking, candidate documentation, interview feedback, offer records, and applicant tracking system data.
* Ensure proper handling of candidate personal data, recruitment records, background verification coordination, and pre\-employment documentation.
* Maintain awareness of India market practices related to notice periods, offer negotiation, counteroffers, candidate drop\-off risk, joining timelines, and pre\-joining engagement.
* Ensure compliance with company recruitment policies, approval workflows, compensation guidelines, documentation standards, data privacy expectations, and employment\-related hiring practices.

eCommerce Post\-Order Operations sits at the core of our online business operations. With thousands of orders fulfilled and returned across Emerging Markets, delivering a seamless, reliable, and efficient experience is critical to meeting growing consumer expectations and creating moments that matter.

* Partner with Digital Innovation and Product/Technology teams to translate operational requirements into scalable system and platform enhancements.
* Modernize Post\-Order Operations through simplification, automation, data insights, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Explore AI\-driven opportunities across exception management, operational insights, predictive issue identification, workflow automation, and decision support.

5\. PEOPLE MANAGEMENT \& LEADERSHIP


* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of Post\-Order Operations professionals.
* Establish clear objectives, shared accountability, and transparent performance expectations across the team.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and consumer\-centric decision\-making.
* Provide steady, supportive leadership during high\-volume trading moments and dynamic operational conditions.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS


* Cluster \& Hub SCM, Logistics, and Warehouse Teams
* Emerging Markets eCommerce Platform Operations, CS, Planning, CX, Analytics, and Partner Program
* Cluster eCommerce Leads and Teams
* IT Service Management Teams
* Digital Innovation and Programs Teams
* Global eCommerce \& Digital Product Teams

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES


* In\-depth understanding of the end\-to\-end eCommerce journey from click to delivery, including returns and reverse logistics.
* Strong knowledge of eCommerce post\-order operations, fulfillment workflows, and supporting technology architectures (OMS, WMS, TMS, and carrier platforms).
* Robust project management capabilities, including roadmap development, business requirements definition, milestone tracking, and operational handover.
* Strong understanding of processes at the intersection of business operations and IT systems.
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and drive outcomes collaboratively across a matrix organization.
* A star in prioritization based on consumer, business, and operational impact, combining detail orientation with an action\-focused mindset.

REQUISITE EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE / MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

title: Employee Relations Business Partner, India (Contractor)
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


Rippling is looking for an Employee Relations Business Partner based in Bangalore, India to join its HR Policy \& Compliance Team to manage employee relations investigations.


You will work closely with a number of stakeholders, including HR Business Partners (HRBPs), Legal, and business leaders, on employee relations investigations.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Assess incoming employee relations concerns, determine the appropriate investigative response, and partner with stakeholders to drive timely and thoughtful resolution.
* Partner closely with Legal to identify and escalate matters requiring a dedicated Legal team investigation.
* Work with HR Business Partners, managers, and business leaders to resolve employee relations matters in a way that is fair, consistent, risk\-aware, and operationally practical.
* Provide practical HR guidance and recommendations that address employee concerns while supporting team effectiveness, manager accountability, and business continuity.
* Draft clear, concise documentation, including case summaries, findings, recommendations, stakeholder updates, playbooks, templates, and business\-facing guidance.
* Track employee relations activity, themes, resolution status, and outcomes in Rippling.
* Identify patterns, root causes, and emerging risks across employee relations matters, and recommend process, training, manager coaching, or policy improvements.
* Help develop and maintain employee relations operating practices, including intake criteria, escalation guidelines, documentation standards, investigation protocols, templates, and cadences.
* Leverage data, AI, and automation to improve employee relations processes, scale case handling, and create better experiences for employees and managers.
* Maintain discretion, confidentiality, neutrality, and professionalism when handling sensitive employee and workplace matters.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 5\+ years of experience in employee relations, HR business partnership, HR compliance, workplace investigations, or a related HR role.
* Strong understanding of employee relations principles, workplace conduct standards, HR compliance considerations, and investigation best practices.
* Experience advising managers and business leaders on sensitive employee matters with sound judgment, discretion, neutrality, and empathy.
* Ability to assess employee relations concerns and determine the right path for HR\-led resolution, stakeholder partnership, or escalation to Legal, Compliance, Security, or another specialized team.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting case summaries, findings, recommendations, playbooks, and stakeholder updates.
* Strong interviewing, fact\-gathering, documentation, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Practical business judgment and strong HR instincts, with the ability to recommend solutions that are fair, consistent, risk\-aware, and operationally realistic.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple matters at once, prioritize urgent issues, and drive work to timely resolution.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with HRBPs, Legal, managers, executives, and other internal stakeholders.
* Ability to use data and case trends to identify recurring issues, improve processes, and support broader employee relations priorities.
* Comfort building structure, improving processes, and operating effectively in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment.
* Interest in using AI and automation to scale HR processes and improve the employee and manager experience.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Law degree, such as a JD or equivalent.
* Experience with Jira, case\-management systems, HRIS tools, or similar tracking platforms.
* Experience supporting a global or multi\-state workforce.
* Experience building employee relations programs, operating models, templates, or playbooks in a scaling company.

**Director Expectations**


* To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..
* They manage the direction of a large team or sub\-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..

* Background in managing or contributing to thought leadership programmes in a B2B context


**Tools \& Platforms**


* Proficient with email creation tools, specifically Stensul or equivalent platforms


* Experienced with intranet and CMS platforms including SharePoint, WordPress, and Drupal


* Comfortable using design and content creation tools such as Stencil for on\-brand visual content


* Fluency with AI tools: hands\-on experience building repeatable workflows using platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT — including structured project creation, prompt design, and operationalising AI assistance across the content lifecycle

The Sourcing Associate is responsible for sourcing goods and services for various business processes within the organization. This role involves Sourcing Execution \& RfX, Management Market \& Supplier Research, Contract \& Supplier Administration, Data Analysis \& KPI Reporting, Value Delivery \& Governance. This role supports Takeda's mission of delivering better health to people and a brighter future to the world.

* Execute RFI, RFP, and RFQ processes for defined Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories (e.g. Professional Services, HR, Facilities, Sales \& Marketing) or spend thresholds under guidance of the Sourcing Lead.

* Lead negotiations with suppliers, driving value and competitive advantage to Takeda.

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Sourcing Execution \& RfX Management**

* Execute RFI, RFP, and RFQ events for Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories under Sourcing Lead guidance, adhering to Takeda procurement policies. Flexibility to work in other categories too

* Ensure all sourcing activities are documented accurately and completed within agreed timelines
* Partner with supporting functions for execution of activities

**Market \& Supplier Research**

* Conduct supplier market research and maintain up\-to\-date supplier landscape knowledge across assigned Indirect and Commercial Indirect categories
* Identify and evaluate potential new suppliers; gather capability, compliance, and pricing information
* Gather pricing benchmarks and market intelligence to support category strategy and sourcing recommendations in SAP Ariba

**Contract \& Supplier Administration**

* Support contract drafting, review coordination, and approval workflows per Takeda Legal and Compliance requirements
* Maintain contract records; monitor renewals, expirations, and performance milestones
* Support supplier onboarding, due diligence, and ethical sourcing compliance checks

**Data Analysis \& KPI Reporting**

* Conduct spend analysis to identify savings opportunities; feed findings into the category savings pipeline

* Ensure all sourcing activities comply with Takeda procurement policies, SOPs, and governance standards

* Shapes strategy upstream through close business partnership
* Deliver total enterprise value beyond savings
* Takes ownership of spend and outcomes end to end
* Uses curiosity, insights, and data to drive better decisions

Exposure to RFI/RFP/RFQ processes and supplier evaluation preferred. Pharmaceutical, biotech, or professional services/marketing services experience an advantage. title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Enterprise Customer Success Manager (Bilingual)**
---------------------------------------------------



MariaDB is making a big impact on the world. Whether you're checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan or ordering takeout – MariaDB is the backbone of applications used everyday. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development.


**Summary**
-----------



The Customer Success Manager will be responsible for the long\-term success, value, and retention of their customer portfolio utilizing our MariaDB database solutions. Leveraging their **English language skills**, they will strengthen and manage the partnership between customers and the company, interacting regularly to build relationships, drive adoption, and provide awareness to all available resources. Through collaboration, they will educate customers to achieve their business goals and maximize value from their investment in our MariaDB solutions. The CSM is the primary point of contact for escalations and is responsible for working in collaboration with a team of Sales Engineers, Account Executives, and other cross\-functional teams, focused on helping our customers achieve their business goals.


**Key Strategic \& Retention Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------------


* Support and engage with customers throughout all stages of their customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, expansion, retention, and advocacy.
* Guide new customers through onboarding for MariaDB deployments, consulting on MariaDB best practices to ensure customers receive value.
* Formulate an ongoing meeting cadence with the assigned portfolio.
* Become a trusted advisor and advocate for customers within the company.
* Understand customers' data management strategies and effectively articulate additional improvements and/or new strategies leveraging MariaDB capabilities.
* Identify proactive opportunities to work with and provide value to customers.
* Proactively address customer experience issues early, collaborating with Technical Support to understand their customer's issue, and assisting as an escalation point of contact.
* Work with Sales Engineers and Professional Services to determine appropriate services for MariaDB upgrades, migrations, deployments, and/or maintenance.
* Conduct regular business reviews within accounts, showcasing value and learning about business goals and priorities.
* Encourage customer participation in company initiatives (Webinars, Roadshows, Product Feedback, etc).
* Responsible for measuring, managing, and improving customer health, engagement, and value realization.
* Coordinate with Account Executives to ensure the upgrade, migration, and/or growth of the customer portfolio.
* Articulate growth plans, expectations, and successes; documented and tracked within success plans.
* Effectively communicate customer needs to other parts of the business and act as a customer champion within the company.
* Work collaboratively and influence other departments to promote customer satisfaction and success.
* Manage and maintain customer portfolio in achieving the company's Net Retention goals.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* 2\-4 Years of experience in customer facing roles within enterprise software
* **Fluent in and ability to speak and write in English**
* Always represent the company in a knowledgeable and professional manner.
* Possess a mix of technical acumen, intellectual curiosity, and interpersonal relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent time management and organization skills.
* Ability to develop and maintain C\-Level relationships.
* Ability to deliver custom ROI analysis for your customer portfolio.
* Comprehensive understanding of customer success principles.
* Strong understanding of MariaDB features, architecture, and common use cases in enterprise solutions.
* Can speak to new features and quickly speak to new releases of MariaDB.
* High attention to detail.
* Proficient in identifying and understanding complex business needs as it relates to MariaDB.


**Location** \- India (Remote)


**Travel** \- Up to 40% within region


### **What's in it for you?**



Impact the world of technology by pushing the boundaries of technology and business models, working at MariaDB, plc. Be part of a game\-changing organization that encourages outside\-the\-box thinking, values empowerment, and is truly shaping the future of the software industry. You'll be collaborating with high\-caliber colleagues around the world, offering unparalleled learning and growth opportunities. We provide a very competitive compensation package, 25 days paid annual leave (plus holidays) and a massive degree of flexibility and freedom, and more.



Salaries for candidates outside the U.S. will vary based on local compensation structures.


**How to Apply**
----------------



If you are interested in this position, please submit your application along with your CV/Resume through our ATS Greenhouse on our MariaDB Careers site.


* At MariaDB we celebrate the diverse experiences and perspectives of our employees because this drives innovation and success. MariaDB is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone.
* MariaDB does not sponsor work visas or relocation.
* MariaDB is committed to providing accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
* MariaDB will not accept agency resumes without a prior contractual agreement with HR. Please do not forward resumes to any recruiting alias or employee directly. MariaDB is not responsible for paying any fees associated with any unsolicited submitted CV/Resumes.

title: Account Executive
description:
Accounts Executive – Operations, Payroll \& Statutory Compliance

**Department:** Finance \& Accounts  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Location:** Remote  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** Finance Manager / Management

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Accounts Executive** to manage day\-to\-day accounting operations, payroll processing, employee\-related statutory compliances, and taxation activities. The candidate will be responsible for accurate and timely processing of salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax (PT), TDS, GST, accounting entries, reconciliations, and statutory filings.

Key Responsibilities1\. Accounting Operations

* Handle day\-to\-day accounting entries and maintain books of accounts.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable.
* Prepare invoices, payment vouchers, receipts, and expense records.
* Maintain ledgers and perform bank and ledger reconciliations.
* Track outstanding receivables and payables.
* Assist with monthly and annual closing of accounts.
* Maintain proper documentation for audits and statutory requirements.
* Work on **Tally / ERP / accounting software** and Excel.

2\. Payroll Management

* Handle **end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing**.
* Collect and verify attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, reimbursements, and other payroll inputs.
* Calculate salaries, deductions, allowances, incentives, and reimbursements.
* Calculate and process **PF, ESI, PT and TDS deductions**.
* Prepare payroll registers and salary statements.
* Generate and distribute employee payslips.
* Process Full \& Final (F\&F) settlements for employees leaving the organization.
* Maintain employee payroll records and resolve payroll\-related queries.

3\. PF, ESI \& Professional Tax

* Handle monthly **PF calculations, challans and ECR filing**.

* Handle **Professional Tax (PT)** calculations, payments, and returns as applicable by state.
* Ensure employee PF/ESI registrations and updates are completed correctly.
* Maintain statutory records and documentation.

4\. TDS \& Tax Compliance

* Calculate monthly **TDS** on salaries and applicable vendor payments.

* Make timely TDS payments.
* Prepare and coordinate quarterly TDS returns, including **Form 24Q** where applicable.
* Support preparation/issuance of employee **Form 16**.
* Handle employee income\-tax declarations and investment proofs.
* Coordinate with tax consultants and auditors when required.

5\. GST \& Other Compliance

* Assist with GST data preparation, reconciliation, payments, and returns.
* Reconcile purchase/sales data with accounting records.
* Maintain GST and tax\-related documentation.
* Coordinate with consultants for statutory filings and notices.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour and tax regulations.

6\. Operations \& MIS

* Coordinate with HR and Operations for attendance, employee master data, joining, exits, and payroll inputs.

* Prepare salary cost, headcount, statutory liability, and expense reports.
* Reconcile payroll with accounting/GL records.
* Monitor statutory payment and filing calendars.

7\. Audit \& Documentation

* Maintain proper accounting, payroll, tax, and statutory records.

* Hands\-on experience with **PF, ESI, PT, TDS and GST**.
* Good knowledge of **Tally/ERP and MS Excel**.
* Strong reconciliation and numerical skills.
* Ability to independently manage monthly payroll and compliance deadlines.

Preferred Skills

* Advanced Excel – VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, reconciliations, MIS.
* Tally Prime / ERP / payroll software experience.
* Good knowledge of Indian accounting and taxation.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate with HR, Operations, employees, auditors and consultants.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

* 100% accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Timely PF, ESI, PT and TDS payments/filings.
* Accurate accounting entries and reconciliations.
* Zero/minimal payroll and statutory errors.
* Timely submission of monthly MIS.
* Proper maintenance of statutory and accounting records.
* Timely closure of employee payroll and F\&F requirements.

description:
### **Job Information**

### **About Us**


BBI is a global data engineering consulting firm that empowers clients to effectively scale and modernize. We combine engineering fundamentals and innovative tools to execute business\-critical, end\-to\-end projects on\-time and on\-budget. We offer expert services across Data Integration, Data Modernization, Data Migration, Data Architecture, Platform Support, and Application Services. Our goal is to provide business value in the most effective way for our clients so clients can focus on growth.  

  

### **Job Description**


Overview  

  

  

We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on Senior Manager – Finance to manage and oversee financial operations across the United States and India. This is an individual contributor role with ownership of accounting, financial reporting, FP\&A, treasury, compliance, audit coordination, and finance process improvement.  

  

  

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in managing finance operations across US and India entities, a sound understanding of US GAAP and Indian accounting standards, and the ability to independently manage financial activities while working closely with the Leadership team and external advisors.  

  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

  

Finance Operations \& Accounting  

  

  

* Own day\-to\-day finance and accounting activities for the US and India entities.
* Manage monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Maintain and reconcile the general ledger, including journal entries, accruals, provisions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Oversee AR/AP activities, including invoicing, collections, vendor payments, and expense management.
* Manage intercompany accounting and reconciliations between US and India entities.
* Maintain fixed asset registers, depreciation schedules, prepaid expenses, accruals, and other accounting schedules.
* Coordinate payroll accounting and ensure accurate recording of payroll\-related transactions.

  

Financial Reporting \& Analysis  

  

  

* Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
* Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting under US GAAP and Indian accounting standards.
* Analyse financial performance, budget vs. actuals, variances, and key financial trends.
* Prepare management reports and provide actionable financial insights to the Leadership team.
* Develop and monitor financial KPIs and reporting dashboards.

  

Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A)  

  

  

* Own the budgeting and forecasting process for US and India operations.
* Prepare financial forecasts, scenario analysis, and long\-range financial plans.
* Monitor revenue, operating expenses, margins, cash flow, and other key financial metrics.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand financial performance and cost drivers.
* Identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities and present recommendations to Leadership.

  

Treasury \& Cash Management  

  

  

* Manage cash flow and working capital requirements across US and India operations.
* Monitor daily/periodic cash positions and payment requirements.
* Manage banking activities and coordinate with banking partners.
* Manage fund transfers between US and India entities.
* Monitor foreign exchange exposure relating to USD and INR transactions.
* Support effective cash\-flow and liquidity planning.

  

Tax, Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance  

  

  

* Coordinate tax and statutory compliance activities for US and India entities.
* Work closely with external tax advisors and consultants on tax filings, assessments, and related matters.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Monitor changes in applicable accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and records to support compliance.

  

Audit \& Internal Controls  

  

  

* Independently coordinate internal and external audits for US and India entities.
* Prepare audit schedules, supporting documentation, and financial information required by auditors.
* Maintain and strengthen financial controls and accounting processes.
* Identify control gaps and implement appropriate corrective actions.
* Ensure integrity, accuracy, and completeness of financial data.

  

Finance Systems \& Process Improvement  

  

  

* Manage finance systems and tools such as QuickBooks Online, Tally, Excel, and Power BI.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial data across accounting and reporting systems.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement within finance operations.
* Improve month\-end close, reconciliations, reporting, and financial control processes.
* Work with internal technology/reporting teams to improve dashboards, reporting, and financial visibility.

  

Business Partnership \& Leadership Support  

  

  

* Act as a key finance partner to the Leadership team for financial and business\-related decisions.
* Provide timely financial analysis, insights, and recommendations to support business planning.
* Independently manage finance\-related queries and requirements from internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate effectively with HR, Operations, Sales, Legal, auditors, tax advisors, and other functions as required.
* Maintain a high level of confidentiality and accuracy while handling sensitive financial information.

  

  

### **Requirements**


Qualifications  

  

  

Education  

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.
* MBA, CPA, CMA, or CA (India) is preferred.

  

Experience  

  

  

* 10\+ years of progressive experience in Finance and Accounting.
* Strong experience managing finance operations across US and India entities.
* Hands\-on experience in accounting, financial reporting, FP\&A, treasury, compliance, and audit.
* Experience working with US GAAP and Indian accounting standards.
* Prior experience in a multinational or globally distributed organisation is preferred.

  

Skills \& Competencies  

  

  

* Strong understanding of US GAAP and Indian accounting standards.
* Strong knowledge of financial reporting, accounting, FP\&A, cash management, and compliance.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel; experience with Power BI, QuickBooks Online, and Tally is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and financial acumen.
* Ability to independently manage multiple finance activities and priorities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High level of ownership, integrity, confidentiality, and accountability.
* Ability to work effectively with global stakeholders across different time zones.

  

Reporting \& Location  

  

  

* Position: Senior Manager – Finance
* Location: Bengaluru
* Work Location: BBI Bengaluru Office
* Reporting To: Leadership Team

title: ERP Security IAM controls & Integrations
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**About the Role**

We are seeking a Manager – ERP Security, IAM Controls \& Integrations to join a major SAP S/4HANA transformation programme. This role will be responsible for shaping and governing identity and access management controls across the ERP landscape, ensuring secure, compliant and scalable access management processes are embedded into the target operating model.


Working closely with ERP, CR\&C, IAM engineering, 2nd line GRC team, and Technology Architecture teams, you will help design and implement identity controls across SAP and non\-SAP platforms as part of Phoenix, supporting a modern, automated and risk\-based approach to access governance.


This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in Identity Governance Administration (IGA), ERP security, SAP GRC Access Control, IAM controls, PAM, and enterprise identity integrations who enjoys working at the intersection of business transformation, technology, and security.


We recognize that candidates may bring expertise from different IAM platforms and SAP environments. We encourage applications from individuals with transferable experience and a desire to learn and grow.


**Key Responsibilities**

ERP Identity \& Access Management


* Lead the design and implementation of identity and access controls across SAP and connected enterprise applications.
* Support the development of a scalable and sustainable ERP access management model aligned to business and security requirements.
* Define and govern role\-based access control (RBAC) principles and access governance processes.
* Ensure least\-privilege and segregation of duties principles are embedded into solution designs.
* Partner with business process owners and security teams to define access models that balance security, compliance and user experience.

Identity Governance Administration (IGA)


* Lead the integration of SAP applications and ERP platforms with enterprise IGA solutions such as SailPoint, Saviynt etc.
* Support implementation of automated access provisioning, certification, approvals and policy enforcement capabilities.
* Define identity governance requirements across workforce, contractor and third\-party populations.
* Drive adoption of access review and attestation processes to strengthen control effectiveness.
* Support the design of target\-state identity governance operating models.

Joiner, Mover, Leaver (JML) Controls


* Design and improve Joiner, Mover and Leaver (JML) processes across SAP and integrated applications, aligning to Sox and other cyber standards.
* Ensure access changes are automated, auditable and driven by authoritative identity sources.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual activities and improve control effectiveness through automation.
* Work with HR, Identity and Security teams to establish robust identity lifecycle management processes.

SAP Security \& GRC


* Collaborate with SAP Security teams to define security requirements for SAP S/4HANA and related SAP platforms.
* Support implementation and optimisation of SAP GRC Access Control capabilities.
* Contribute to Segregation of Duties (SoD) frameworks, risk analysis and mitigating controls.
* Support audit, compliance and assurance activities related to ERP access management.
* Provide guidance on SAP authorisations, access controls and governance processes.

PAM \& Non\-Human Identity Management


* Support governance of privileged access across ERP applications and supporting infrastructure including Emergency Access management ( EAM) in SAP GRC AC.
* Partner with PAM teams to implement controls for privileged and emergency access.
* Contribute to the development of controls for service accounts, technical users, APIs, bots and other non\-human identities.
* Help establish governance processes for the lifecycle management of non\-human identities.

Authentication \& Identity Integration


* Support implementation of Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) and federation capabilities.
* Define identity integration requirements between SAP platforms and enterprise identity services.
* Work with architecture and engineering teams to implement secure identity flows across hybrid and cloud environments.
* Help ensure a consistent user identity experience across the SAP ecosystem.

Controls, Risk \& Compliance


* Ensure IAM controls align with enterprise security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support risk assessments and control reviews relating to identity and access management.
* Contribute to audit readiness and remediation activities.
* Track and manage identity\-related risks, issues and control improvements.

**Qualifications and Skills**

Essential


* Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).
* ERP security and access management.
* SAP Security and SAP GRC Access Control.
* SailPoint , Saviynt or similar IGA platforms.
* Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Identity lifecycle management and JML processes.
* Access governance, certifications and access reviews.
* Authentication technologies including SSO and MFA.
Enterprise application integrations and identity architecture.  
* 

**Job Posting End Date**

2026\-08\-31  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.  



**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.  



**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

description:

**Pay Band:** Grade 7 / F

**Contract Type:** Indefinite Contract

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for an experienced \*\*Product Manager\*\* to play a critical role in designing, implementing and maintaining innovative and effective HR technology solutions across the British Council.


Working within the People Experience and Insight pillar, you will act as a key link between the People function, Digital \& Technology teams and our managed service partners and external suppliers. You will translate business requirements into practical system solutions, drive continuous optimisation and ensure our HR technology landscape supports effective, consistent and user\-friendly ways of working.  



**You will:**

* Translate business requirements into system configurations, workflows and technical specifications.
* Drive optimisation by identifying inefficiencies in People processes and implementing practical technology\-enabled improvements.
* Ensure HR systems provide a consistent and user\-friendly experience through testing, feedback and continuous improvement.
* Support HR transformation initiatives by implementing system changes aligned with organisational restructuring and process updates.
* Ensure system configurations meet data security, privacy and local legal requirements.
* Work closely with vendors and internal stakeholders to deliver timely fixes, enhancements and integrations.
* Support the effective use of HR technology and AI initiatives across the People function.
* Act as a technical system consultant, advising the business on system capabilities and future requirements.
* Support standardised global ways of working through consistent system usage and configurations.
Contribute to the ongoing performance, development and delivery of the British Council’s HR technology landscape.  
* 

**About the Role**

This role sits within the People Experience and Insight pillar, which is responsible for the British Council’s HRIS technology landscape and for working closely with our outsourced service partner to embed transformational ways of working through technology.


You will work across a complex, global and matrixed organisation, collaborating with People function teams, Digital \& Technology, People Insight, external suppliers and our managed service partner. The role will focus particularly on supporting the continued development and optimisation of systems including SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and Eightfold, as well as their integration with the wider HR technology landscape.


You will be involved in business projects and transformation initiatives, ensuring that changes to HR processes, organisational structures and ways of working are effectively translated into system functionality.  



**Main Opportunities and Responsibilities**

**Service Delivery**

* Work closely with People function teams to embed AI initiatives and maximise the effective use of HR technology.
* Partner with the People Insight team to maintain high\-quality system data and identify process or training gaps.
* Work with vendors and Digital \& Technology teams to investigate and resolve complex issues involving multiple technology and infrastructure components.
* Work with the managed service partner to conduct system audits, ensuring appropriate security, data protection and compliance with local legal requirements.
* Work directly with the outsourced partner to assign, track and deliver system changes and resolve system issues.
* Support technology\-driven process improvements across the People function.
* Ensure alignment between HR operations and system capabilities through continuous engagement with business teams.
* Drive consistent system usage and configurations to support standardised ways of working.
* Gather and document detailed business requirements and translate them into technical specifications for development teams.
* Support day\-to\-day HRIS system performance and delivery within the People Experience and Insight pillar.
Act as a technical system consultant for current and future business requirements, ensuring organisational and process changes are aligned with system functionality.  
* 

**Analysis and Problem\-Solving**

* Apply technical knowledge of SuccessFactors and Eightfold to investigate complex business issues and identify effective solutions.
* Provide advice and support to People Policy and Process teams as they develop and enhance HR process architecture.
* Work with the managed service partner to deliver and project manage small\-scale functional enhancements and change initiatives.
Analyse business requirements and system capabilities to identify opportunities for improved efficiency, consistency and user experience.  
* 

**Relationship and Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues across the British Council, the managed service partner and external suppliers.
* Collaborate with internal and external cross\-functional teams to integrate HRIS with other business systems.
* Communicate technical requirements and solutions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
Influence stakeholders and partners to adopt effective, standardised and technology\-enabled ways of working.  
* 

**About You**

We are looking for an experienced HR technology professional who can combine strong technical knowledge with a practical understanding of HR processes and business requirements.


You will have significant experience managing HR systems within a large and complex organisation, ideally with experience of working in a global or matrix environment. You will bring strong hands\-on experience of **SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central** , together with experience of other SuccessFactors modules and HR technology solutions.


You will be confident translating business needs into system requirements, investigating complex problems and working with internal teams, vendors and managed service partners to deliver effective solutions. You will also have the communication and influencing skills required to work effectively with stakeholders across a diverse organisation.  



**Essential Requirements**

* Significant experience managing HR systems within a large and complex organisation with matrix structures.
* At least **3–4 years’ experience working with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central** and other modules as a System Consultant or Implementation Specialist.
* Experience standardising and implementing global HR processes within SuccessFactors.
* Demonstrable experience providing expert advice and guidance to stakeholders and contributing effectively to internal and external communications and meetings.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex HR technology issues and identify practical solutions.
* Experience working with technology vendors, managed service providers and cross\-functional teams.
Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and system solutions.  
* 

**Desirable Requirements**

* SAP SuccessFactors certification in Employee Central and/or more than one Talent module.
Experience working within a global organisation.  
* 

**Core Skills and Capabilities**

You will demonstrate:


* Communicating and Influencing – Level 3: Uses formal and informal influencing, negotiating and motivation techniques to achieve effective outcomes while respecting different views and cultures.
* Managing Projects – Level 3: Supports projects from requirements definition through planning, implementation and evaluation, managing change and coordinating diverse stakeholders.
* Planning and Organising – Level 2: Supports the implementation of plans while balancing business and customer requirements and competing priorities.
Analysing Data and Problems – Level 2: Examines a range of information to identify patterns, trends and options and solve complex problems.  
* 

You will also bring developing or foundational capability in **data literacy, business acumen, customer understanding, digital agility and executional excellence** , with a focus on using technology and data to deliver efficient, scalable and impactful HR solutions.  



**Language Requirements**

The British Council’s systems and global processes operate in English. Written and verbal proficiency in English is required.  



**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to play a key role in the continued transformation of the British Council’s People function through technology. You will work across a global HR technology landscape, collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders and contribute to solutions that improve the experience, efficiency and effectiveness of HR services across the organisation.


The British Council is committed to creating an open, inclusive and expert environment where colleagues can bring different perspectives, work collaboratively and make a meaningful impact.


Our values are **Open and Committed; Expert and Inclusive; Optimistic and Bold** . These values guide how we work, make decisions and build relationships with colleagues, partners and the communities we serve.  



**Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for ensuring that they have the legal right to live and work in the country where the role is based. Please check the visa and right\-to\-work requirements applicable to your location before applying.


Initial and continuing employment with the British Council is subject to an annual background check. This role is subject to Standard Screening.


The British Council is committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from candidates with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.

title: Administration and Finance Officer
description:
Role Purpose

The Finance \& Administration Officer will provide accurate, efficient and confidential finance and administrative support across the organisation and its care home services.

The postholder will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, processing invoices and payments, supporting payroll and staff administration, monitoring purchasing and expenditure, maintaining company records and providing timely management information.

The role requires a high level of organisation, attention to detail and confidentiality, together with an understanding of the operational environment of residential and nursing care.

The postholder will work closely with senior management, registered managers, care home teams, suppliers, employees, residents and external professionals to ensure that financial and administrative processes are accurate, compliant and efficiently managed.

Key Responsibilities1\. Finance Administration

* Process sales and purchase invoices accurately and within agreed timescales.
* Raise invoices for residents, local authorities, NHS\-funded placements and other commissioners.
* Monitor outstanding invoices and support the credit\-control process.
* Maintain accurate records of payments received and payments due.
* Process supplier invoices and ensure appropriate authorisation is obtained before payment.
* Reconcile supplier statements and investigate discrepancies.
* Assist with bank reconciliations and maintain accurate financial records.
* Maintain petty cash records and reconcile cash balances.
* Process expenses and staff reimbursement claims in accordance with company procedures.
* Assist with month\-end finance procedures and reporting.
* Maintain accurate records for audit purposes.
* Identify unusual transactions, discrepancies or potential errors and escalate these promptly.

2\. Resident Fees and Funding

* Maintain accurate records of resident fee arrangements.
* Monitor changes to funding arrangements, including self\-funding, local authority and NHS\-funded placements.
* Ensure changes to weekly fees, funding periods and discharge dates are accurately reflected in financial records.
* Liaise with care home managers and commissioners regarding outstanding financial information.
* Maintain records supporting resident invoices and statements.
* Follow up overdue resident accounts professionally and sensitively.
* Escalate significant or disputed debts to senior management.

3\. Purchasing and Supplier Administration

* Process purchase orders and supplier invoices in accordance with company procedures.
* Maintain an up\-to\-date supplier database.
* Monitor recurring expenditure and supplier contracts.
* Check invoices against agreed prices, purchase orders and delivery information.
* Identify discrepancies, duplicate invoices or unexpected charges.
* Support management with supplier reviews and cost\-control exercises.
* Maintain records of service contracts, renewal dates and supplier contact details.

4\. Payroll and Staff Administration

* Provide administrative support for the monthly payroll process.
* Maintain accurate records of new starters, leavers, changes to pay, working hours and other payroll information.
* Liaise with managers regarding timesheets, overtime, sickness, annual leave and other payroll\-related information.
* Ensure payroll information is submitted within agreed deadlines.
* Maintain confidential employee records.
* Support the administration of employment documentation and staff changes.
* Maintain records relating to statutory and mandatory training, DBS checks, right\-to\-work documentation and other employment compliance requirements where required.
* Escalate discrepancies or concerns relating to payroll or employee records to the appropriate manager.

5\. General Administration

* Maintain organised electronic and paper\-based records.
* Manage routine correspondence, emails and documentation.
* Prepare letters, reports, spreadsheets and management information as required.
* Maintain company and care\-home administrative records.
* Support senior management with meetings, documentation and follow\-up actions.
* Maintain filing systems and ensure documents can be retrieved promptly for audit, inspection or management purposes.
* Assist with preparation of documentation for CQC, local authority, NHS, financial and other regulatory requirements.
* Ensure confidential information is handled appropriately and securely.

6\. Compliance and Governance

The postholder will contribute to the organisation's governance framework by ensuring that financial and administrative records are:

* Accurate and complete.
* Current and appropriately authorised.
* Easily accessible for audit and inspection.
* Maintained in accordance with company policies and procedures.
* Handled in accordance with confidentiality and data\-protection requirements.

The postholder will promptly report any suspected financial irregularity, fraud, inappropriate expenditure, data breach or significant administrative error to senior management.

7\. Management Information

* Produce regular finance and administrative reports as requested.
* Assist with monitoring income, expenditure, outstanding debts and supplier balances.
* Support management with budget monitoring.
* Highlight significant variances or unusual expenditure.
* Assist with preparation of financial information for management meetings.
* Maintain accurate spreadsheets and databases.

Key Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

* Strong numerical and financial administration skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
* Ability to maintain accurate records.
* Ability to work with confidential and sensitive information.
* Strong organisational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to prioritise competing deadlines.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to identify errors and discrepancies.
* Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively to a wider team.
* Professional and courteous communication with residents, families, staff, suppliers and external organisations.
* Good problem\-solving skills.
* A strong understanding of the importance of financial controls and authorisation procedures.

ExperienceEssential

* Previous experience in finance, accounts or administration.
* Experience processing invoices and maintaining financial records.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working with confidential information.
* Experience working to deadlines and maintaining accurate records.

Desirable

* Experience within health or social care.
* Experience with payroll administration.
* Experience with accounting software such as Sage, Xero or equivalent.
* Experience with resident billing or local authority/NHS funding.
* Experience working within a regulated environment.
* AAT qualification or equivalent finance/accounting experience.

Personal Attributes

The postholder should be:

* Reliable and trustworthy.
* Highly organised.
* Detail\-oriented.
* Proactive rather than reactive.
* Discreet and professional.
* Confident in identifying and challenging discrepancies appropriately.
* Able to maintain confidentiality.
* Comfortable working with senior management and operational teams.
* Flexible and willing to support the wider organisation when required.
* Committed to the values and standards of Professional Care.

Confidentiality

The Finance \& Administration Officer will have access to confidential financial, employee, resident and business information.

The postholder must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all relevant company policies, data\-protection requirements and information\-governance procedures.

Financial Controls

The postholder must operate within the organisation's financial\-control framework and must not authorise, approve or process transactions outside their delegated authority.

Any suspected fraud, financial irregularity, conflict of interest, duplicate payment or unexplained transaction must be reported immediately to senior management.

Performance Measures

Performance will be assessed against:

* Accuracy of financial records.
* Timely processing of invoices and payments.
* Accuracy and timeliness of resident billing.
* Timely completion of payroll administration.
* Accuracy of reconciliations.
* Management of outstanding debts.
* Quality and organisation of administrative records.
* Compliance with company procedures.
* Responsiveness to managers and operational teams.
* Ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Contribution to effective financial control and cost management.

Working Relationships

The Finance \& Administration Officer will work closely with:

* Company Directors.
* Registered Managers.
* Finance/Accounts team.
* Care home managers and administrative staff.
* HR and payroll providers.
* Employees.
* Residents and their representatives where appropriate.
* Local authorities.
* NHS/ICB representatives.
* Suppliers and contractors.
* External accountants, auditors and professional advisers.

Overall Responsibility

The Finance \& Administration Officer is expected to support the organisation in maintaining **accurate finances, effective administrative systems, strong financial controls and reliable management information**, while recognising the particular confidentiality, regulatory and operational requirements of a care\-home environment.

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
