title: Deputy Manager/Manager
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**BRIEF TEAM/DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION:**



Team is responsible for designing and executing global regulatory strategies to ensure the timely approval of a diverse portfolio of pharmaceutical products and the lifecycle maintenance of these products. The team works across multiple complex projects, facilitating various types of submissions to agencies like the FDA, EMA, MHRA or EU National Authorities, HC, and other international authorities, by ensuring compliance with evolving regulations.


**PRINCIPLE RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Drive end\-to\-end regulatory strategies for product registration and approval across US, EU, UK, Canada markets by managing the submissions including Pre\-INDs, Scientific Advice (ScAs), Pediatric Investigation Plans (PIPs), and Notified Body Opinions etc.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end preparation, review, and filing of regulatory dossiers (NDAs, NDSs, and MAAs (CP, DCP, MRP, NPs) etc. to ensure timely submissions.
* Lead cross\-functional team discussions to align submission strategies, define priorities, and establish realistic timelines based on evolving regulatory requirements.
* Perform global regulatory due diligence and comprehensive gap assessments to identify potential risks and mitigation strategies for US, EU, UK, and Canada filings.
* Manage the review and approval of artwork, including SPCs and PILs, ensuring adherence to current standards.
* Manage regulatory readiness for launch in compliance with evolving EU and UK regulations.
* Hands on experience in handling activities related to xEVMPD, RIMS, PLM, IRIS, etc.
* Support the assessment of promotional materials to ensure regulatory compliance, as needed.
* Direct post\-approval regulatory activities, including supplements, variations, and renewals, to ensure continuous compliance throughout the product lifecycle, as needed.
* Monitor evolving, region\-specific regulations and proactively provide strategic guidance to cross\-functional teams to ensure compliance


**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Lead the development and execution of end\-to\-end regulatory strategies for pharmaceutical products across the US, EU, UK, Canada markets.
* Ensuring successful submissions including Pre\-INDs, ScAs, NDAs, NDSs, and MAAs (CPs, DCPs, MRPs, NPs) etc.
* Manage Health Authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA or National Authorities, HC) communications and secure timely/required feedback and approvals.
* Provide regulatory support for international territories, ensuring compliance and continuity in lifecycle maintenance.
* Oversee lifecycle management activities, including supplements, variations, and other post\-approval regulatory submissions on need basis.


**Qualifications and Education Requirements**


* 8\+ years of experience in pharmaceutical regulatory affairs for US, EU, UK, Canada markets
* Master of Science in Pharmaceuticals or Equivalent
* Regulatory Affairs exposure to China and Emerging markets would be considered a plus
* Ability to perform under pressure with limited resources
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in English
* Strong writing analytical and problem\-solving abilities

If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

Higher Education Administration

About the Role

We are looking for a **capable, mature and highly driven professional** for a multidisciplinary role covering **HR, recruitment, business operations, management coordination, accounts \& GST support, compliance, project coordination and administration**.

The role requires someone with **strong communication skills, professional presence, ownership and the ability to deal effectively with people**. The person will act as an important day\-to\-day interface between management, employees and operational functions, ensuring that routine matters are coordinated, followed up and brought to proper closure.

Key ResponsibilitiesHR \& Recruitment

* Prepare and publish job vacancies across suitable recruitment platforms.
* Source, screen and shortlist candidates.
* Conduct preliminary candidate interaction and screening.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews.
* Assist management throughout the interview and selection process.
* Manage candidate communication and recruitment follow\-ups.
* Coordinate joining, onboarding and induction activities.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Act as a key day\-to\-day point of contact for employees.
* Handle routine employee queries, concerns and workplace matters.
* Communicate management directions and ensure appropriate follow\-up.
* Assist in employee performance, conduct and work\-related follow\-ups.

Management Coordination

* Act as an execution and coordination link between management and employees.
* Follow up on management instructions and ensure timely implementation.
* Obtain updates from employees and teams on pending work.
* Identify delays, gaps and matters requiring attention.
* Resolve or coordinate routine matters independently where appropriate.
* Escalate significant matters to management with clear and concise information.
* Maintain confidentiality and discretion while dealing with employee and management matters.

Accounts, GST \& Compliance

* Perform accounts\-related data entry, processing and record maintenance.
* Organise invoices, financial records and supporting documentation.
* Assist in preparation of GST workings and returns.
* Maintain accounting and compliance information throughout the financial year.
* Keep records organised and ready for Chartered Accountant review and finalisation.
* Coordinate with the company’s Chartered Accountant and other professional consultants.
* Assist with STPI\-related filings and documentation.
* Assist with RBI\-related filings and applicable compliance requirements.
* Maintain registration, licence and renewal records.
* Track statutory and regulatory deadlines.
* Prepare and organise documents required for filings, renewals and submissions.

Business Operations \& Project Coordination

* Maintain operational and project trackers.
* Monitor pending tasks and follow up with concerned team members.
* Support routine PMO, Agile and Scrum\-style coordination where required.
* Coordinate meetings, task updates and work follow\-ups.
* Track deadlines, blockers and pending deliverables.
* Ensure assigned activities are followed through to completion.
* Prepare concise updates and status information for management.
* Promote accountability and organised execution across day\-to\-day operations.

Administration \& General Operations

* Coordinate vendors and service providers.
* Assist with purchases, quotations and routine procurement.
* Negotiate and compare options with a focus on value and cost efficiency.
* Coordinate maintenance and general office requirements.
* Maintain administrative documentation and renewal records.
* Help maintain proper workplace organisation and operational standards.
* Identify avoidable expenditure, inefficiencies and opportunities for savings.
* Step into routine operational matters wherever coordination, ownership or follow\-through is required.

Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:

* **Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.**
* **Proficiency in spoken and written English.**
* Strong professional presence and maturity.
* Confidence in dealing with employees and candidates at different levels.
* Ability to communicate firmly, professionally and tactfully.
* High level of ownership and responsibility.
* Good judgement and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to organise, coordinate and follow multiple matters simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-up skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with discretion.
* Good computer literacy and ability to work comfortably with office software, spreadsheets and online systems.
* Willingness and ability to learn HR, accounting, GST, compliance, project\-management and administrative processes.

Education \& Experience

Candidates should be **suitably educated** and demonstrate aptitude relevant to areas such as:

* People management / HR
* Business operations
* Accounting / finance
* Taxation / GST
* Regulatory compliance
* Project management / Agile
* Administration
* Business communication
* Information systems and data processing

**The specific degree or academic stream is not the primary criterion.**

Candidates from different educational backgrounds may be considered where they demonstrate the required **calibre, communication ability, maturity, ownership and learning aptitude**.

**Freshers with exceptional calibre as well as experienced candidates are welcome to apply.**

Previous exposure to HR, recruitment, accounts, GST, compliance, administration, PMO or business operations will be an advantage, but candidates with the right capability and aptitude can also be trained.

Important

This is a **multifunctional and ownership\-driven position**, not a narrow desk or data\-entry role.

The selected candidate may at different times be involved in recruitment, employee coordination, GST/accounting preparation, regulatory filings, project follow\-ups, vendor coordination, administration and management execution.

Candidates should therefore be comfortable taking responsibility across different areas and working closely with management.

**This position is based entirely in Srinagar and requires regular physical presence at the workplace. Remote or hybrid working is not available.**

description:
Job Description
**Title:** Associate Director – Talent Acquisition (Academia Hiring)


**Location:** Mumbai/ Delhi/ Bangalore


**Role Overview**
**About Emeritus \& Daskalos**
================================================

Emeritus is redefining global education by making high\-quality learning accessible and affordable for individuals, companies, and governments. Through partnerships with over 80 world\-class universities, Emeritus delivers industry\-relevant programs across formats, including short courses, degrees, and executive programs \- to more than 300,000 learners across 80\+ countries.  

Daskalos, a strategic initiative of Emeritus, pioneers' transnational education in India by helping leading global universities establish joint campuses under the evolving Indian regulatory framework. With over 15 institutions in advanced discussions, Daskalos is shaping the next chapter in global higher education.  

We are seeking an experienced and strategic **Associate Director – Talent Acquisition (Academia Hiring)** to lead end\-to\-end recruitment of academic talent across diverse disciplines and Universities. The incumbent will be responsible for building a strong faculty talent ecosystem, attracting world\-class educators, researchers, academic leaders, and international faculty, while partnering closely with academic and institutional leadership to support the university's growth agenda. The incumbent would hire for multiple global university JVs under the India Branch Campuses (IBC) entity.


This role requires deep expertise in higher education recruitment, extensive networks within academia, strong understanding of faculty hiring practices, and the ability to engage senior stakeholders including Deans, Provosts, Vice Chancellors, Academic Councils, and international faculty communities.


The ideal candidate will have successfully recruited faculty and academic leadership talent for reputed Indian and global universities with multicultural teaching environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**


**Academic Talent Acquisition Strategy**


* Develop and execute a comprehensive faculty and academic leadership hiring strategy aligned with institutional growth plans.
* Lead recruitment initiatives across, Provosts, Deans, Directors, Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors, Lecturers, Research Faculty, Post\-Doctoral Fellows, Early Career Faculty, Adjunct Faculty, Visiting Faculty, International Faculty.
* Build annual and multi\-year faculty workforce plans in partnership with academic leadership.
* Establish robust sourcing and talent mapping mechanisms for niche and emerging academic disciplines.

**Faculty Talent Pipeline Development**


* Create strong faculty talent pipelines from:

	+ Foreign Higher Education Institutions (FHEIs)
	+ Top global universities
	+ Indian Institutes of Eminence and leading universities
	+ Indian\-origin faculty working overseas
	+ Returning diaspora talent
	+ Expatriate faculty communities
	+ Research institutions and think tanks
* Develop long\-term relationships with doctoral candidates, post\-doctoral researchers, and emerging academic talent globally.
* Leverage academic conferences, scholarly networks, professional associations, journals, and research forums to identify high\-potential faculty talent.
* Maintain an active database of global academic talent across disciplines.

**Stakeholder \& Leadership Management**


* Partner closely with Vice Chancellors, Provosts, Deans, Academic Directors, Department Heads, Governing Boards, International Academic Partners.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on faculty hiring trends, compensation benchmarking, talent availability, and market intelligence.
* Influence senior stakeholders through data\-driven hiring recommendations and talent insights.
* Drive consensus across multiple academic and administrative stakeholders during faculty selection processes.

**Academic Recruitment Operations**


* Manage end\-to\-end faculty hiring lifecycle including Talent mapping, Candidate sourcing, Screening and evaluation, Academic credential verification, Research profile assessment, Stakeholder coordination, Offer management, Onboarding.
* Design and implement best\-in\-class faculty assessment frameworks.
* Facilitate global recruitment processes for international candidates and expatriates.
* Ensure superior candidate experience for academic and leadership hires.

**Academic Policies \& Market Intelligence**


* Demonstrate strong understanding of higher education ecosystem and faculty career frameworks.
* Provide advisory support on:

	+ Faculty promotion and tenure systems
	+ Faculty performance management
	+ Research grants and funding ecosystems
	+ Faculty development initiatives
	+ Academic governance structures
	+ Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)
	+ Research impact assessment
	+ Accreditation requirements
	+ Internationalization of faculty
* Monitor global trends in academia and recommend innovative hiring approaches.

**Employer Branding \& Networking**


* Strengthen the institution’s brand within academic communities globally.
* Represent the organization at Academic conferences, Faculty recruitment forums, Research symposiums, international education events.
* Build strategic partnerships with universities, research institutions, professional associations, and academic networks.

**Team Leadership**


* Establish hiring KPIs and recruitment effectiveness metrics.
Drive continuous improvement through recruitment analytics and process excellence.  
* 

**Required Qualifications**


**Education**


* Master's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Higher Education Administration, or related field.
* Additional certifications in Talent Acquisition, Executive Search, or HR preferred.

**Experience**


* 12–18\+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition experience.
* Minimum 7–10 years of dedicated experience in **higher education/academic recruitment**.
* Demonstrated success in hiring large volumes of academic talent across faculty and leadership levels.
Experience in institutions having a diverse mix of Indian and expatriate faculty is highly preferred.  
* 

**Required Competencies**


**Functional Competencies**


* Deep expertise in academic hiring and faculty search methodologies.
* Strong understanding of higher education ecosystem and university governance.
* Faculty talent mapping and market intelligence capabilities.
* Knowledge of global academic talent markets.
* Understanding of research\-oriented hiring and faculty evaluation frameworks.
* Expertise in hiring international and Indian\-origin foreign faculty.
* Strong knowledge of faculty compensation structures and academic career progression.

**Leadership Competencies**


* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Ability to engage and build credibility with senior academic leaders globally.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills.
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving orientation.
* High levels of professionalism, confidentiality, and judgment.
* Strong negotiation and relationship\-building skills.
Ability to operate effectively in a multicultural and international environment.  
* 

**Key Success Metrics**

description:
Job Description
**About Emeritus**


Emeritus is committed to teaching the skills of the future by making high\-quality education accessible and affordable to individuals, companies, and governments around the world. It does this by collaborating with more than 80 top\-tier universities across the United States, Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia, India and China.


Emeritus’ short courses, degree programs, professional certificates, and senior executive programs help individuals learn new skills and transform their lives, companies and organizations. Its unique model of state\-of\-the\-art technology, curriculum innovation, and hands\-on instruction from senior faculty, mentors and coaches has educated more than 300,000 individuals across 80\+ countries.


Founded in 2015, Emeritus, part of Eruditus Group, has more than 1,800 employees globally and offices in Mumbai, New Delhi, Shanghai, Singapore, Palo Alto, Mexico City, New York, Boston, London, and Dubai. The company is backed by prominent investors including Accel, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Leeds Illuminate, Prosus Ventures, Sequoia Capital India, and Bertelsmann.


**Job Description**

**Title**: Associate Director – Talent Acquisition (Professional Services Hiring – Academia)

description:
**FINANCIAL MODELLING TRAINEE – INFRASTRUCTURE**

**Company: Urban Grey Engineering Solutions**

**Location: Kozhikode, Kerala**

**Employment Type: Full\-time – Trainee**

**Experience: Fresher / 0–1 Year**

**Qualification: MBA / PGDM – Finance**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Urban Grey Engineering Solutions is looking for a highly analytical and motivated Financial Modelling Trainee – Infrastructure to join our Infrastructure Advisory team.

The selected candidate will work closely with our engineering, DPR and project teams to develop financial models and financial analyses for urban and infrastructure projects.

This position is suitable for an MBA/PGDM Finance fresher or early\-career professional with strong numerical ability, excellent Microsoft Excel skills and a keen interest in infrastructure finance, project finance, financial modelling and investment analysis.

The selected candidate will receive practical exposure to real\-world infrastructure projects and will be trained to translate technical project inputs such as CAPEX, OPEX, implementation schedules and revenue assumptions into structured financial models.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

\- Develop and maintain Excel\-based financial models for infrastructure and urban development projects.

\- Prepare long\-term project cash\-flow projections based on project CAPEX, OPEX, revenue and financing assumptions.

\- Assist in preparation and analysis of Project IRR, Equity IRR, NPV, DSCR, payback period and other financial indicators.

\- Develop CAPEX, OPEX, revenue and lifecycle financial projections based on inputs received from engineering and project teams.

\- Prepare debt schedules covering loan drawdown, interest, principal repayment and debt\-servicing requirements.

\- Assist in evaluating different combinations of debt, equity, grants and other financing sources.

\- Develop project\-specific revenue models covering user charges, rentals, lease income, commercial revenue, parking revenue, advertisement income and other potential revenue streams.

\- Prepare sensitivity and scenario analyses for changes in CAPEX, OPEX, revenue, demand, interest rates and other key project assumptions.

\- Assist in evaluating the financial viability, affordability and sustainability of infrastructure projects.

\- Support preparation of financial sections of DPRs, feasibility reports, business plans, investment proposals and project appraisal reports.

\- Assist in preparation of financial dashboards, charts, presentations and management summaries.

\- Work closely with Civil Engineers, Architects, Quantity Surveyors and other technical professionals to understand project assumptions and incorporate them into financial models.

\- Assist in research and analysis of infrastructure financing, Government funding programmes, municipal finance, PPP models and asset monetisation opportunities.

\- Maintain proper documentation of financial assumptions, calculations, model versions and supporting data.

\- Support senior management and project teams in financial analysis and project\-related presentations as required.

**QUALIFICATION**

* MBA / PGDM in Finance – Required
* Candidates who have recently completed their MBA/PGDM or are in the final stage of completion may apply.
* Candidates with an undergraduate background in Engineering, Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics or other quantitative disciplines will have an added advantage.

**EXPERIENCE**

Freshers and candidates with up to 1 year of experience may apply.

Previous internship/project exposure in any of the following will be an added advantage:

\- Financial Modelling

\- Project Finance

\- Infrastructure Finance

\- Investment Analysis

\- Corporate Finance

\- Financial Analysis

\- Banking / NBFC

\- Consulting / Advisory

Prior infrastructure\-sector experience is not mandatory.

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS**

\- Strong Microsoft Excel skills

\- Good understanding of financial statements and cash flows

\- Basic understanding of NPV, IRR and time value of money

\- Strong numerical and analytical ability

\- Ability to work with large datasets and financial assumptions

\- Good understanding of basic finance concepts

\- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

\- Logical and structured problem\-solving ability

\- Good written and verbal communication skills

\- Ability and willingness to learn infrastructure and project finance

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

Exposure to any of the following will be an advantage:

\- Advanced Excel Financial Modelling

\- Project Cash\-Flow Modelling

\- NPV / IRR Analysis

\- Debt \& Interest Calculations

\- DSCR Analysis

\- Sensitivity Analysis

\- Revenue Forecasting

\- Project Finance

\- Infrastructure Finance

\- PPP

\- Power BI / Financial Dashboards

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

We are looking for a Finance professional with strong analytical and financial modelling aptitude, rather than an accounting or bookkeeping profile.

The ideal candidate should enjoy working with numbers, Excel models, financial assumptions and analytical problems and should be interested in understanding how large infrastructure projects are planned, financed and made financially sustainable.

The candidate should be comfortable working closely with engineering professionals and learning the technical and commercial fundamentals of infrastructure projects.

Strong Excel skills and willingness to develop advanced financial modelling capabilities are essential for this position.

**LEARNING \& CAREER EXPOSURE**

The selected candidate will receive hands\-on exposure to:

* Infrastructure Financial Modelling
* Project Finance
* Urban \& Municipal Infrastructure Finance
* CAPEX \& OPEX Modelling
* Revenue Modelling
* Debt \& Repayment Modelling
* NPV, IRR \& DSCR Analysis
* Financial Viability Assessment
* PPP \& Commercial Structuring
* Asset Monetisation
* Government Infrastructure Funding
* DPR \& Feasibility Study Financial Analysis

The position provides an opportunity to develop into an Infrastructure Finance \& Financial Modelling professional while working on live multidisciplinary engineering and infrastructure projects.

ABOUT URBAN GREY

Urban Grey Engineering Solutions is a multidisciplinary engineering and infrastructure consultancy providing services across Urban Infrastructure, Buildings \& Structures, Water \& Wastewater, Water Resources \& Hydrology, Environmental Infrastructure, Architecture, MEPF, DPR Preparation and Project Management Consultancy.

The selected candidate will work alongside our multidisciplinary technical teams and gain practical exposure to the financial and commercial aspects of infrastructure development.

title: Community & Business Development Associate – Fresher
description:
**Ecosystem Growth \& Community Relations Associate**

* **Company:** Recro
* **Location:** Bangalore, India (With pan\-India event travel as required)
* **Type:** Full\-Time (Fresher / Early Career)
* **Role Focus:** Community Building, Networking, and Ecosystem Engagement (Non\-Sales)

**About Recro**  
Recro is a premier developer\-first platform and talent partner. We work closely with high\-growth startups, established big\-tech companies, and Global Capability Centers (GCCs) helping them build, scale, and anchor their engineering foundations in India. We don't just fill positions; we foster tech ecosystems, connect elite talent with pathbreaking opportunities, and build long\-term relationships within the tech community.  
**Role Overview**  
Are you someone who loves keeping up with the latest in tech, naturally gravitates toward meeting new people, and thrives in lively social or professional gatherings?  
We are looking for an energetic, curious, and relationship\-driven **Ecosystem Growth \& Community Relations Associate** to represent Recro out in the real world. This is **not** a traditional desk\-bound quota\-driven sales job. Instead, you will act as Recro’s brand ambassador—stepping into tech conferences, developer meetups, hackathons, and startup mixers across Bangalore and pan\-India.  
Your goal is simple: immerse yourself in the tech community, connect with engineering leaders and founders, share what Recro is building, and organically build a vibrant network of partners and tech enthusiasts.  
**What You Will Do**

* **Be the Face of Recro:** Attend premier tech events, developer conferences, startup summits, and networking mixers across Bangalore and pan\-India to represent our brand ethos.
* **Engage \& Build Genuine Relationships:** Strike up organic conversations with engineering managers, tech founders, product leaders, and innovators. Listen to their scaling challenges and share how Recro’s ecosystem supports them.
* **Stay Ahead of Tech Trends:** Read up on emerging technologies, cloud landscapes, AI advancements, and startup ecosystem shifts so you can talk shop comfortably with tech professionals.
* **Map the Ecosystem:** Identify key community hubs, upcoming tech forums, and emerging pockets of innovation where Recro should have a presence.
* **Collaborate Internally:** Bring back grassroots insights, qualitative feedback, and warm community connections to align with our growth and outreach teams.

**What We Are Looking For (Who You Are)**

* **Fresher with High Agency:** You have recently graduated and possess an undeniable "hunger to build", a self\-motivated attitude, and a strong bias for action—you don't wait to be told what to do.
* **Extracurricular Champion:** Your college or early background isn't just about academics; you were deeply involved in organizing college fests, leading clubs, debating societies, cultural events, or tech symposiums.
* **A Natural Conversationalist:** You genuinely love talking to new people, possess high emotional intelligence, and find energy in networking rather than draining from it.
* **Tech\-Curious:** You have an active interest in reading about technology, following tech creators, understanding how startups scale, or tracking software development trends.
* **Willingness to Travel:** Excited about stepping out, visiting venues, hopping across city tech hubs, and traveling pan\-India for major industry events.

**Why Join Recro?**

* **Zero Boredom:** No cold calling scripts or rigid pitch decks. Your office is wherever the tech community gathers.
* **Accelerated Growth:** Learn directly from startup founders, tech executives, and community leaders while building a powerful professional network early in your career.
* **Culture of Ownership:** Work in a high\-trust, collaborative environment where your ideas matter, your individuality is celebrated, and your impact is visible from day one.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you currently based in Bangalore, or are you willing to relocate to Bangalore?
* Are you comfortable attending in\-person technology events, conferences, meetups and networking activities?
* Please share a 30–60 second video introducing yourself and telling us why you would enjoy a networking and community\-focused role.

description:
**Hardware \& Networking Technical Assistant**

**Company:** KavinTech Corporation  
**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka, India  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday (6 days a week)  
**Salary:** ₹21,000 per month  
**Experience:** Freshers with relevant training/certification OR experienced candidates  
**Joining:** Immediate joiners preferred  
**Commitment:** Minimum 1\-year commitment required

**About KavinTech Corporation**

KavinTech Corporation is a Bangalore\-based technology provider with 19\+ years of experience, specializing in customized software development and enterprise\-level technology solutions. The company works with development organizations and national\-level projects across India, providing end\-to\-end software and technology solutions.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a **Hardware \& Networking Technical Assistant** to support our IT infrastructure and assist senior technical staff in maintaining hardware, networking, servers, connectivity, and end\-user systems.

This is a hands\-on, on\-site role involving system maintenance, LAN/WAN troubleshooting, network equipment configuration, workstation setup, and technical support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**System \& Hardware Maintenance**

* Clean and maintain PCs, servers, routers, switches, printers, and other IT equipment.
* Perform regular physical cleaning and dust\-free upkeep of systems.
* Inspect RAM, HDD/SSD, cables, power connections, and other hardware components.
* Perform basic hardware troubleshooting and replacement when required.
* Set up and configure new desktops, laptops, and workstations.
* Assist with server, UPS, and power\-backup maintenance.
* Coordinate the delivery and installation of new laptops and IT equipment.

**Networking \& Connectivity**

* Inspect, label, organize, and maintain Ethernet cables and network ports.
* Perform Cat6 cabling, cable crimping, IO port punching, and patch\-panel organization.
* Test LAN connectivity using ping, tracert/traceroute, and other diagnostic tools.
* Troubleshoot faulty network cables, ports, and connectivity issues.
* Diagnose basic WAN and internet connectivity problems.
* Verify correct LAN/WAN port connections.
* Assist with Cisco L2/L3 switch configuration and maintenance.
* Assist with Cisco and Aruba router configuration and maintenance.
* Configure and manage Wi\-Fi access points.
* Assist with VPN, domain, firewall, and network\-security management.

**Server \& Software Support**

* Assist with installation and maintenance of in\-house servers.
* Install and configure software according to development and technology requirements.
* Provide remote system management and configuration support.
* Support Windows and Linux\-based systems.

**Technical Support**

* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues reported by employees.
* Escalate complex issues to senior technical staff.
* Maintain records of maintenance activities and recurring technical problems.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve system and network outages.
* Provide technical assistance to clients when required.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on understanding of Ethernet networking and LAN/WAN concepts.
* Basic knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, FTP, VPN, LAN, and WAN.
* Basic understanding of switches, routers, Wi\-Fi, access points, and network cabling.
* Knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
* Ability to use basic networking diagnostic commands such as ping and tracert/traceroute.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Attention to detail and proper documentation habits.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

**Preferred Technical Exposure**

Candidates with knowledge or training in the following will be preferred:

* Cisco L2/L3 switches and routers
* Aruba networking equipment
* VMware / Hyper\-V
* Windows Server
* Linux / Ubuntu / CentOS
* AWS / Azure / Google Cloud / OpenStack
* Wireshark
* Nagios
* Nessus
* Endpoint security tools
* Norton Ghost / system imaging

**Candidate Eligibility**

* Diploma / Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Networking, or a related field.
* **Freshers with relevant Hardware \& Networking training and a valid course/training certificate can apply.**
* **Candidates with prior hardware/networking experience are also encouraged to apply.**
* Must have a practical understanding of basic hardware and networking concepts.
* **Kannada language proficiency is preferred**
* Knowledge of English and/or Tamil will be an advantage.
* **Candidates below 25 years of age are preferred.**
* **Candidates from Karnataka will be preferred.**
* Candidates from other South Indian states may also be considered.
* **Immediate joiners are preferred.**
* Must be willing to work on\-site in Bangalore.
* **Minimum 1\-year commitment is required.**

**Salary \& Accommodation**

* **Salary: ₹21,000 per month**
* **Accommodation will be provided if required by the candidate.**
* Accommodation is subject to company availability and applicable company terms.
* **Food will not be provided.**
* Candidates who already have their own accommodation in Bangalore may also apply.

**Important Job Conditions**

* **Work from home is not available.**
* **Working days: Monday to Saturday (6 days per week).**
* **Duty hours: 8 hours per day.**
* **Minimum 1\-year commitment is required.**
* The position is based at the company's Bangalore office.
* Candidates must be comfortable with hands\-on hardware and networking work.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates may send their updated CV along with relevant **Hardware \& Networking training certificates** or previous experience details to:

**Email:** hr@kavinsoft.com  
**Contact:** \+91 74834 32701

**Company Website:** https://www.kavintech.com

**Preference:** Candidates from **Karnataka**, with good Kannada communication skills, relevant technical training/certification or experience, and immediate availability will be preferred.

title: Finance & Accounts Executive
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a young, energetic and hands\-on Finance \& Accounts professional to manage day\-to\-day

finance operations across all our offices and business verticals.

This is a role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, is highly organised, comfortable working across time zones

and is willing to roll up their sleeves and get things done. The person will work closely with internal teams,

management, clients, vendors and external stakeholders to ensure that financial processes, payments, collections,

reporting and documentation are handled efficiently and on time.

The role will also involve supporting the wider team with client servicing and operational tasks during periods of

lower finance activity, making this an ideal opportunity for someone who wants exposure to multiple aspects of a fast\-growing sports and entertainment business.

**Finance \& Accounts Operations**

* Manage day\-to\-day finance and accounting activities across all offices and business verticals.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date financial records and documentation.
* Process vendor, client and operational payments in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure invoices, bills and supporting documents are received and processed correctly.
* Maintain records of accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Assist with bank reconciliations, ledger maintenance and routine accounting activities.
* Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, tax consultants and other finance partners where required.

**Receivables \& Collections**

* Track incoming payments and outstanding receivables.
* Follow up proactively with clients and partners for pending payments.
* Maintain accurate collections and outstanding payment trackers.
* Escalate delayed or overdue payments to the relevant internal stakeholders.
* Ensure incoming funds are correctly identified, recorded and reconciled.

**Reporting \& MIS**

* Prepare regular finance and management reports.
* Maintain trackers for payments, receivables, expenses, reimbursements and cash flows.
* Assist management with financial data and reports required for decision\-making.
* Support monthly and periodic financial closing activities.
* Ensure financial information is accurate, organised and readily accessible.

**Tally \& Accounting Systems**

* Maintain accounting records and transactions in Tally.
* Ensure invoices, expenses, payments and receipts are correctly recorded.
* Assist with reconciliations and identifying discrepancies.
* Maintain proper documentation for all financial transactions.
* Support improvements to internal finance processes and reporting systems.

**Payroll \& Employee Finance**

* Coordinate with the relevant internal teams and external partners for monthly payroll processing.
* Assist with collecting and verifying payroll inputs.
* Manage employee reimbursements and expense claims.
* Verify supporting documentation and ensure reimbursements are processed within timelines.
* Maintain accurate records of employee\-related financial transactions.

**Multi\-Office \& Time\-Zone Coordination**

* Coordinate finance activities across multiple offices and geographies.
* Be comfortable communicating with teams, clients and partners across different time zones.
* Follow up on time\-sensitive financial matters and ensure important tasks do not get delayed due to geography or working hours.
* Maintain a high level of responsiveness when urgent finance matters arise.

**Client Servicing \& Business Support**

* During periods of lower finance activity, support the wider team with basic client servicing and operational responsibilities.
* Assist with client communication, coordination, follow\-ups and administrative requirements.
* Support internal teams with event, hospitality, ticketing or other operational requirements when needed.
* Be willing to take on additional responsibilities and contribute wherever the team needs support.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Fresher with a background in Accounts/Finance OR 1–2 years of relevant experience.
* Graduate in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or a related field preferred.
* Basic understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.
* Comfortable working with Tally, Excel/Google Sheets and other basic finance tools.
* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Good communication and follow\-up skills.
* Highly organised and capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Young, energetic and eager to learn.
* Proactive attitude with a strong “get it done” mindset.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.
* Willing to work across time zones when required.
* Comfortable communicating with clients, vendors and internal teams.
* Willing to step outside a traditional finance role and support the broader business when required.

**What We're Looking For**

This role is best suited to someone who is hungry to learn, takes ownership and doesn't wait to be told what needs to be done.

You will have the opportunity to work across finance operations for a growing sports and entertainment business, while gaining exposure to clients, events, hospitality, ticketing, partnerships and international operations.

The ideal candidate is someone who can start with a finance task in the morning, follow up on an international payment in the afternoon, coordinate a reimbursement, help prepare a report and, when required, jump in to support the client servicing team.

If you're energetic, organised, accountable and ready to hustle, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

Sports For Life is a multi\-sport academy, running structured coaching programs across Badminton, Table Tennis, Football, and Tennis in Mumbai and Pune. We help children and adults discover, learn, and grow in the sport of their choice through professional coaching, quality infrastructure, and a member\-first experience. As a Pre\-Sales Executive, you will be the first point of contact for prospective members. You will engage inbound and outbound leads, understand their needs, recommend the right program, and drive them through the funnel — from first conversation to trial booking to enrolment. This is a target\-driven, phone\-first role ideal for someone who enjoys talking to people, is persistent in follow\-ups, and takes ownership of conversions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make outbound calls to leads generated from digital campaigns, referrals, walk\-ins, and other sources.
* Respond promptly to inbound inquiries across phone, WhatsApp, and other channels.

* Book trial sessions and coordinate schedules with center teams and coaches.
* Follow up rigorously across the funnel: pre\-trial reminders, post\-trial closing, and re\-engagement of dormant or undecided leads.
* Handle objections, share pricing and program details, and drive prospects toward enrolment.

* Capture and log lost\-lead reasons accurately to support funnel improvement.
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly targets for call volume, trials booked, and enrollments.
* Coordinate with center managers and coaches to ensure a smooth prospect experience from inquiry to trial.
* Share regular updates with the Pre\-Sales Manager on lead status, pipeline, and blockers.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Excellent verbal communication skills in English, Hindi, and Marathi.
* 2–4 years of experience in tele\-sales, inside sales, pre\-sales, or a customer\-facing role. Freshers with strong communication and the right attitude may be considered.
* Comfortable making a high volume of calls daily and staying persistent with follow\-ups.
* Target\-oriented mindset with the drive to meet and exceed conversion goals.
* Basic comfort with CRM tools, spreadsheets, and WhatsApp\-based communication.
* Good listening skills, empathy, and the ability to handle objections professionally.
* Graduate in any discipline.

* Prior experience in ed\-tech, sports, fitness, wellness, or services sales.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Daily call volume and connect rate.
* Number of trials booked.
* Trial\-to\-enrollment conversion rate.
* Monthly enrollments / revenue contribution.
* Lead follow\-up discipline and CRM data hygiene.

**What We Offer**

* Fixed salary plus a performance\-linked incentive structure.
* Training on our programs, sales process, and CRM tools.
* A clear growth path within the pre\-sales and sales function.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. **Job Purpose:**

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **8th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Engineering based in India.**
 This is a pivotal technical leadership opportunity within an early\-stage wearable sensing and robotics environment. The role owns end\-to\-end engineering execution for a body\-worn sensing platform, from system architecture through production. You will lead a distributed team of hardware specialists across India and the US while remaining deeply hands\-on with critical technical challenges. The position spans power systems, sensor synchronization, firmware, embedded Linux, mechanical engineering, and system integration. Your decisions will directly influence product reliability, wearability, performance, and the capabilities of the underlying technology. This is an on\-site role in India with regular travel to San Francisco, approximately one week per month.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Own end\-to\-end technical execution of a body\-worn sensing platform, from architecture and prototyping through production and shipping.
* Lead and coordinate a distributed engineering team across India and the US, maintaining technical quality and effective collaboration across time zones.
* Define and maintain the overall hardware system architecture, ensuring mechanical, electrical, power, sensor, and firmware subsystems integrate into a cohesive wearable product.
* Make critical design and integration decisions involving power systems, sensor synchronization, firmware, embedded Linux, and mechanical structures.
* Translate product requirements into clear, actionable engineering briefs that enable distributed teams to execute effectively.
* Apply first\-principles engineering to power architecture, including multi\-rail battery systems, protection circuits, regulator selection, inrush behavior, brownouts, and schematic analysis.
* Solve complex sensor synchronization challenges involving mismatched sample rates, variable bus latency, firmware timestamping, and real\-world dataset alignment.
* Debug firmware and system\-level issues using schematics, logic analyzers, serial logs, and other diagnostic tools.
* Review and challenge mechanical designs with a focus on engineering integrity, wearability, durability, load paths, tolerance stack\-ups, and strain relief.
* Take hands\-on ownership of critical technical systems and evaluate their impact on product performance and underlying model capabilities.
* Shape hiring criteria, interview processes, and team development practices as the engineering organization grows.
* Support supply chain, vendor management, manufacturing handoff, regulatory compliance, and production scale\-up where required.


**Requirements**
* 6–10\+ years of hardware engineering experience developing wearable devices, robotics, motion\-capture systems, or field\-deployed hardware.
* Proven experience taking at least one hardware product through the complete development lifecycle, from initial prototype to deployment with real end users.
* US citizenship or a valid US visa is required; visa sponsorship is not available.
* Willingness to be based on\-site in India and travel to San Francisco approximately one week per month.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise in battery\-powered and multi\-rail power systems, including protection circuits, regulator topologies, inrush current, brownout analysis, and schematic review.
* Strong experience with sensor synchronization across different sample rates and variable bus latencies, including firmware\-level timestamping and diagnosis of real\-world data misalignment.
* Practical firmware and embedded Linux expertise, including bringing up SoM/SBC platforms and debugging timing, interrupts, buffers, and related system issues.
* Strong mechanical engineering judgment, including understanding of load paths, tolerance stack\-ups, strain relief, durability, and wearable ergonomics.
* Previous experience operating as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Founding Engineer, or in a similarly senior technical capacity, rather than solely as an engineering manager.
* Demonstrated ability to lead distributed technical teams and maintain engineering standards without relying on daily in\-person oversight.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to translate product requirements into precise engineering specifications and execution briefs.
* Experience with hardware supply chains and vendor management is an advantage.
* Familiarity with UL/IEC regulatory requirements for wearable devices is a plus.
* Experience with manufacturing handoff and hardware production scale\-up is desirable.


**Benefits**
* Salary: $140,000–$210,000 USD annually.
* Significant technical ownership at a critical stage of growth within the wearable sensing and robotics space.
* Opportunity to shape the engineering architecture, technical standards, and culture of a growing organization.
* Hands\-on involvement across hardware, firmware, mechanical engineering, sensing, and system integration.
* Opportunity to lead and develop a distributed engineering team across India and the United States.
* On\-site work in India with regular travel to San Francisco, approximately one week per month.
* Opportunity to directly influence product quality, reliability, and the capabilities of the underlying technology.


**How Jobgether Works**

* Monitor lead ageing, maintain accurate CRM/DMS records, and analyze lost leads to improve conversion.
* Conduct effective **vehicle demonstrations and test drives**, explaining key product features and benefits and collecting customer feedback and purchase intent.
* For EVs, demonstrate relevant features such as **charging process, driving modes, range information, regenerative braking, and EV operating functions**.
* Explain finance, insurance, exchange, offers, schemes, discounts, and commercial terms transparently and coordinate with respective teams for customer requirements.
* Prepare accurate quotations, booking forms, KYC, and other required documentation and explain payment schedules and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with **Sales Administration, Finance, Insurance, Exchange, RTO, PDI, and Delivery teams** to ensure smooth order processing and vehicle delivery.
* Ensure the correct **model, variant, color, accessories, and customer requirements** are fulfilled before delivery.
* Maintain regular communication with customers from enquiry through booking, payment, documentation, delivery, and post\-delivery follow\-up.
* Build long\-term customer relationships, generate **referrals and repeat business**, and support CSI/NPS and overall customer satisfaction.
* Address initial customer concerns and coordinate with relevant departments for timely resolution of escalated issues.
* Monitor competitor **EV/PV/CV products, pricing, features, offers, technologies, and customer propositions**.

title: Script Writer + Manager
description:
Fable Labs is looking for a **Script Writer / Creative Writer** who can turn products, consumer problems and random observations into video ideas people actually want to watch.

We create **UGC ads, short\-form video ads, creator\-led content and performance marketing creatives** for D2C and consumer brands.

We're not looking for someone who only knows how to write grammatically correct sentences.

We're looking for someone who can think:

**Hook → Problem → Story → Product → Proof → Payoff**

If you regularly save interesting ads, analyse why certain Reels work, write funny observations in your Notes app, or instinctively think *“this could be a great ad”* when something happens around you, this role might be for you.

What You'll Be Writing

You will work on:

* UGC Ad Scripts
* Instagram \& Facebook Ad Scripts
* Short\-Form Video Scripts
* Performance Marketing Ads
* Creator\-Led Advertisements
* Product Demonstration Scripts
* Testimonials
* Problem\-Solution Ads
* Skits
* Conversational Ads
* Vox Pop Concepts
* Hooks \& Opening Lines
* Multiple Hook Variations
* D2C Product Ads
* Social Media Content
* Creative Concepts \& Campaign Ideas

What You'll Do

As a Script Writer at Fable Labs, you'll:

* Write engaging short\-form video scripts for brands
* Research products, competitors and target customers before writing
* Develop strong hooks that can capture attention within the first few seconds
* Turn product features into interesting consumer stories
* Write natural dialogue that doesn't sound like traditional advertising
* Create UGC\-style scripts that actors and creators can deliver naturally
* Generate multiple creative angles for the same product
* Write multiple hook variations for creative testing
* Develop skits, scenarios, visual gags and storytelling concepts
* Study winning advertisements and understand why they work
* Use customer reviews, comments and pain points while developing scripts
* Work with videographers, editors, actors and the creative team
* Modify scripts based on client and creative feedback
* Think about how every line will actually be shot instead of writing scripts that only look good on paper

Skills We're Looking For

You should have a good understanding of:

* Script Writing
* Creative Writing
* Copywriting
* Storytelling
* Social Media Content
* Short\-Form Video
* Advertising
* Instagram Reels
* Consumer Psychology
* Hooks \& Attention
* Research
* D2C / E\-commerce Brands

You should be comfortable writing in **English and conversational Hinglish** when required.

Perfect grammar alone isn't enough.

We care more about whether you can understand **people, humour, problems, products and attention.**

Who Should Apply?

You could be:

* A Script Writer
* Creative Copywriter
* Content Writer
* Social Media Writer
* Advertising Copywriter
* Creative Strategist
* Content Creator
* Screenwriter interested in advertising
* Marketing student with strong writing ability
* Fresher with an excellent writing portfolio

**Freshers are welcome to apply if they can demonstrate strong creative thinking.**

Your degree matters much less to us than your ability to come up with ideas.

What We're NOT Looking For

This probably isn't the right role if your writing is primarily:

* SEO blogs
* Generic ChatGPT\-generated articles
* Corporate website copy
* Long\-form informational content
* Rewritten versions of competitor ads

This role is heavily focused on **ideas, scripts, hooks and advertising concepts.**

We want writers who can take something as simple as underwear, skincare, perfume, a gadget or a household product and find an unexpectedly interesting way to sell it.

A Typical Creative Challenge Might Look Like:

**Product:** Men's underwear

Instead of simply writing:

“Made with comfortable and breathable fabric.”

We'd want you thinking:

**What's the awkward situation where this feature suddenly matters?**

Can it become a date story?

An office situation?

A gym moment?

A conversation between two friends?

A ridiculous visual demonstration?

A confession?

A comparison?

A skit?

That's the kind of thinking this role requires.

About Fable Labs

Fable Labs is a creative advertising agency working with D2C and consumer brands.

We treat creative work like a laboratory.

We experiment with:

**Hooks. Scripts. Actors. Formats. Visual demonstrations. Stories. Editing styles.**

Then we learn what works and use those learnings to make the next creative stronger.

You'll get to write across different products, categories and advertising formats rather than producing the same kind of content every day.

Why Join Fable Labs?

You'll get hands\-on exposure to:

* D2C Advertising
* UGC Ads
* Performance Marketing Creatives
* Creative Strategy
* Consumer Research
* Video Production
* Actors \& Creators
* Script Testing
* Hook Testing
* Advertising Psychology
* Real Brand Campaigns

More importantly, you'll actually get to **see your scripts become videos.**

You'll be able to watch an idea go from:

**Random thought → Script → Shoot → Edit → Live Ad**

And then learn from how that creative performs.

Job Details

**Position:** Script Writer – Social Media \& Video Ads

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Location:** Thane / Mumbai

**Work Mode:** On\-site

Application Requirement

Please share any relevant writing samples, scripts, advertisements, social media content or portfolio while applying.

If you don't have professional experience yet, you may also share **3–5 original sample ad concepts or scripts** that demonstrate how you think.

We care less about how many years you've been writing and more about whether reading your idea makes us think:

**“We should shoot this.”**

* Commuter assistance

description:
The Sales Consultant is responsible for generating and converting vehicle sales enquiries for **Electric Vehicles (EV), Personnel Vehicles (PV), and Commercial Vehicles (CV)**. The role involves customer handling, product demonstration, test drives, lead follow\-up, quotation and negotiation, finance/insurance coordination, booking, and delivery support while achieving assigned sales targets and maintaining high customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle and professionally manage **showroom, online, telephone, referral, digital, and field enquiries** while understanding customer requirements, budget, usage, and purchase preferences.
* Recommend suitable **EV, Personel Vehicle (PV), and Commercial Vehicle (CV)** models and variants based on customer needs and application.
* Provide accurate information on vehicle features, specifications, pricing, offers, warranty, finance, insurance, accessories, and after\-sales support.
* Achieve **monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets** by converting enquiries into test drives, bookings, and retail deliveries.
* Maintain strong knowledge of **EV technology, battery performance, driving range, charging requirements, charging infrastructure, warranty, running costs, maintenance, and ownership benefits**.

* Monitor lead ageing, maintain accurate CRM/DMS records, and analyze lost leads to improve conversion.
* Conduct effective **vehicle demonstrations and test drives**, explaining key product features and benefits and collecting customer feedback and purchase intent.
* For EVs, demonstrate relevant features such as **charging process, driving modes, range information, regenerative braking, and EV operating functions**.
* Explain finance, insurance, exchange, offers, schemes, discounts, and commercial terms transparently and coordinate with respective teams for customer requirements.
* Prepare accurate quotations, booking forms, KYC, and other required documentation and explain payment schedules and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with **Sales Administration, Finance, Insurance, Exchange, RTO, PDI, and Delivery teams** to ensure smooth order processing and vehicle delivery.
* Ensure the correct **model, variant, color, accessories, and customer requirements** are fulfilled before delivery.
* Maintain regular communication with customers from enquiry through booking, payment, documentation, delivery, and post\-delivery follow\-up.

* Graduate in any discipline.

About the Role

We are looking for a **passionate, confident and growth\-oriented Travel Consultant** who can understand clients' travel requirements, suggest the right travel solutions and successfully convert leads into bookings.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication and convincing skills, a customer\-focused approach and the ability to understand client requirements and recommend suitable **international and domestic travel packages**.

This is not just a regular sales position. We are looking for someone who wants to **grow with TRIPTOKART**, take ownership, develop leadership skills and eventually take responsibility for managing a team.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle incoming travel leads through calls, WhatsApp, email and other communication channels.
* Understand the client's travel requirements, budget, preferences, duration and expectations.
* Prepare and suggest customized travel itineraries and packages according to client requirements.
* Explain package inclusions, hotels, flights, sightseeing, transfers, activities, visas and other travel services.
* Follow up with leads consistently and professionally.
* Convert qualified leads into confirmed bookings.
* Negotiate and communicate effectively with clients while maintaining company margins.
* Maintain strong relationships with clients throughout the sales process.
* Coordinate with the operations team, hotels, airlines, DMCs and other vendors whenever required.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, follow\-ups, quotations and conversions.
* Achieve individual monthly sales and conversion targets.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, referrals and upselling.
* Handle client objections professionally and convert them into opportunities.
* Ensure a smooth handover of confirmed bookings to the operations team.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident and comfortable speaking with clients.
* Excellent in communication and negotiation.
* Target\-oriented and passionate about sales.
* Good at understanding customer psychology and requirements.
* Capable of handling multiple leads and follow\-ups simultaneously.
* Willing to learn about international destinations, travel products and the tourism industry.
* Responsible, disciplined and professional.
* Comfortable working in a target\-driven environment.
* Interested in building a **long\-term career in the travel industry**.
* Someone who doesn't just want a job but wants to **grow into a leadership position**.

Growth Opportunity

At TRIPTOKART, we are looking for people who want to grow with the company.

A candidate who consistently performs well, takes responsibility and demonstrates leadership qualities can progress through roles such as:

**Travel Consultant → Senior Travel Consultant → Team Leader (TL) → Assistant Manager → Sales Manager → Department/Business Head**

As the company grows, you will have the opportunity to **build and manage your own team, train new consultants, monitor performance, handle targets and take ownership of a sales vertical.**

Performance Expectations

Your growth will be based on:

* Lead conversion performance
* Sales achievement
* Client handling
* Follow\-up discipline
* Customer satisfaction
* Revenue generation
* Teamwork
* Leadership ability
* Ownership and responsibility
* Consistency and overall performance

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and performance.
* Attractive performance\-based incentives.
* Exposure to international travel products and destinations.
* Professional and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Training and guidance on travel sales and destination knowledge.
* Opportunity to work with a growing travel company.
* Career progression based on performance.
* Opportunity to become a **Team Leader / Manager** as the company expands.
* Opportunity to build and manage your own team in the future.

Important
