title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 We’re building a travel platform spanning
 **Flights, Hotels, and Experiences** 
 for one of the largest telecom operators in Europe. The product brings together multiple travel partners and integrates deeply with the telecom’s loyalty ecosystem to create a seamless booking experience for millions of users.
   

  

 We’re looking for an
 **Associate Product Manager / Product Manager** 
 who is excited by the challenge of building products from the ground up. You’ll work across the entire product lifecycle—from identifying customer problems and defining solutions to launching features, measuring their impact, and continuously improving the experience.
   

  

 This role doesn’t end at launch. Once the product is live, you will work closely with users, analyze data, identify opportunities, and drive product\-led growth initiatives that improve conversion, engagement, retention, and customer satisfaction. You’ll play a key role in shaping the product into one that customers love and one that delivers meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

 If you’re someone who enjoys solving customer problems, making data\-driven decisions, and taking ownership from idea to impact, you’ll thrive in this role.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Help build and scale the Flights, Hotels, and Experiences product from the ground up.
* Own product initiatives from discovery and problem definition through launch and post\-launch optimization.
* Work closely with engineering, design, business, and external partners to deliver high\-quality product experiences.
* Translate customer problems and business opportunities into clear product requirements and PRDs.
* Define priorities, manage execution, and ensure timely delivery of product initiatives.
* Analyze user behavior, funnel metrics, customer feedback, and business performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Design, prioritize, and execute product\-led growth initiatives to improve acquisition, conversion, engagement, repeat usage, and retention.
* Run experiments, measure outcomes, and iterate rapidly based on customer insights and data.
* Coordinate with integration partners to ensure reliable and scalable customer experiences.
* Continuously refine the product based on user feedback, analytics, and evolving business needs.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 2 to 4 years of product management experience building consumer or marketplace products.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data to drive product decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to simplify complex problems into intuitive customer experiences.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with ambiguity.
* Curiosity to understand customers, technology, and business—not just feature requirements.


 Above all, we’re looking for someone with a strong sense of ownership. Someone who treats the product as their own, takes initiative without waiting to be asked, and is driven to create meaningful customer and business impact. We value people who are naturally curious, proactive, and passionate about building great products \- people who don’t stop once a feature is launched but continuously look for ways to make the product better.
   

  

**We’d Love to See**
**Role**
 While not a requirement, we’d especially love to hear from candidates who have demonstrated a strong builder mindset outside their day\-to\-day role. This could include:
   

  

* Founding or being an early member of a startup.
* Building a meaningful side project, product, business, or venture from scratch.
* Pursuing entrepreneurial experiences that required taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, and learning by doing.
* Choosing an unconventional career path to build something of your own before or alongside a corporate role.


 These experiences aren’t mandatory, but they often reflect the qualities we value most \- ownership, resourcefulness, resilience, and a bias toward action. If you have built something you are proud of, we would love to hear about it.

**A Note on Incentives**

The incentive amount for this role is paid once the originating project reaches successful installation and commissioning — not at the point of lead conversion, appointment booking, or contract signing alone.

**Content \& Digital Marketing Executive**

**Department:** Marketing \& Growth

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, 6\-day work week

**Location:** Chennai (covering Chennai, Kanchipuram, Thiruvallur \& Chengalpattu)

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a creative, growth\-focused Content \& Digital Marketing Executive to build Roofglow's local brand presence and directly drive qualified leads. Beyond content, you own our entire digital presence and every channel that generates leads — and you're expected to personally convert a share of the enquiries your own content brings in, not just hand them off.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Content Creation \& Video Editing***

* Shoot, edit, and publish short\-form video reels, customer testimonials, and installation showcases across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and LinkedIn.
* Ensure every piece meets a consistent quality bar — clean colour correction, clear audio, and tight pacing — and is delivered on time.
* Visit installation sites, coordinating with the Installation \& Execution Supervisor, to capture footage.

***Lead Generation \& Campaign Management***

* Set up and optimize localized Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google ad campaigns to generate warm solar leads.
* Own Roofglow's full digital presence and every channel that generates leads — website, social, and listings.
* Own Roofglow's SEO end to end — on\-page optimization, local search/Google Business Profile, and keyword strategy — so the website and PM Surya Ghar listing rank well for local searches.
* Keep an eye on what fellow solar brands in the area are doing and adapt content/campaigns accordingly.

***Digital Sales \& Enablement***

* Handle initial social media/WhatsApp DM conversations, engage prospective buyers directly, and convert straightforward enquiries yourself where possible; hand off more complex leads into the Telecaller/Solar Consultant pipeline.
* Coordinate daily with the Inside Sales Executive so leads generated by content are followed up promptly.

***BTL \& Local Activations***

* Plan and coordinate localized awareness drives, canopy setups, pamphlets, handbills, and customer events across the coverage area.
* Build and maintain a small network of local vendors (printers, event/canopy suppliers) to support promotional activities.

***Performance Tracking***

* Track content and campaign performance (reach, engagement, cost\-per\-lead, conversion) and report on what's working.
* Where available, keep an eye on broader digital metrics too (e.g. website traffic), not just lead\-linked ones.

**Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Visual Communication, New Media, or a related field is preferred; however, a strong portfolio can substitute for the degree requirement.

**Experience:** Freshers with strong practical skills are welcome; 1–3 years of experience in video editing, social media management, or digital marketing execution is a strong advantage.

* Video/graphics: Adobe Premiere Pro / CapCut / Canva / Photoshop
* Ad tools: Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads Manager, Google Analytics
* Communication/CRM: Meta Business Suite, WhatsApp Business, Google Workspace
* Strong working knowledge of SEO — on\-page optimization, local SEO, and keyword research — this is a required skill, not a nice\-to\-have
* Familiarity with basic motion graphics is a plus, though not required

* Comfortable engaging prospective customers directly, not just producing content for others to convert

title: Junior Developer / Software Engineering Intern
description:
WANT TO KICK START YOUR IT CAREER? Then you are at right place,

I’m looking for a junior developer or intern who can take responsibility for day\-to\-day development and maintenance of our web and mobile products.

This is not a role where you will only be assigned small, isolated tasks. I’m looking for someone who can gradually take ownership of features and projects, understand how the product works end\-to\-end, test their own work properly, troubleshoot issues, and work closely with senior developers.

The ideal person should be curious, responsible, comfortable learning new technologies, and willing to take ownership rather than waiting for instructions for every small task.

Technical Exposure

Depending on the project, you may work with:

\* React

\* TypeScript

\* Expo

\* React Native

\* Android

\* Java

\* Kotlin

\* XML

\* Jetpack Compose

\* REST APIs and backend integrations

\* Git/GitHub

\* Debugging, logging, and troubleshooting

\* Testing across web and mobile

\* Other relevant technologies as required by the projects

You do not need to be an expert in all of these technologies. Strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly are more important.

Responsibilities

\* Maintain and improve existing websites and applications.

\* Develop new features for web and mobile applications.

\* Work closely with senior developers on ongoing projects.

\* Understand existing codebases and make changes without breaking existing functionality.

\* Test features end\-to\-end before considering them complete.

\* Debug issues across frontend, mobile, API, and integration layers.

\* Investigate problems independently before escalating them.

\* Fix bugs and handle small\-to\-medium development tasks independently.

\* Work with Git and follow proper development practices.

\* Help monitor and maintain existing products.

\* Take responsibility for assigned features and make sure they are properly implemented, tested, and delivered.

\* Communicate clearly when something is blocked, unclear, or needs senior\-level input.

What Matters Most

I care more about your approach to development than knowing every technology listed above.

You should:

\* Take ownership of your work.

\* Be comfortable asking questions when necessary.

\* Be willing to investigate problems independently.

\* Understand that development includes testing and debugging, not just writing code.

\* Be comfortable working on an existing codebase.

\* Pay attention to details.

\* Be willing to work across different technologies when a project requires it.

\* Be comfortable working closely with senior developers.

\* Be willing to learn and improve continuously.

\* Take responsibility for the outcome of your work.

Ideal Candidate

This role would be a good fit for someone who may not have extensive professional experience yet but has strong fundamentals, personal projects, internship experience, or a genuine interest in software development.

I would rather work with someone who knows less but takes ownership, learns quickly, and thinks through problems than someone who knows a particular framework but needs to be guided through every task.

Experience

\* Internship / 0–2 years of professional development experience.

\* Freshers with strong projects and fundamentals are welcome.

\* Experience with React, React Native, Android, or similar technologies is a plus.

\* Personal projects, GitHub projects, or previous internships can be considered as relevant experience.

Working Style

You will work closely with senior developers and should be comfortable receiving feedback, discussing implementation decisions, and improving your approach.

The expectation is that as you gain familiarity with the products and codebase, you should be able to take increasing ownership of features and projects.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**The Opportunity (6\-Month Internship)**
 This isn't a typical recruiting internship. It's an opportunity to learn how a world\-class Talent Acquisition team helps scale an enterprise SaaS company.
   

  

 At Sitetracker, Talent Acquisition is a strategic partner to the business—not simply a function that fills vacancies. During your six\-month internship, you'll get to work alongside experienced Talent Acquisition professionals and hiring leaders to help attract exceptional talent that will shape the future of our company.
   

  

 You'll learn what differentiates a good candidate from a truly exceptional one, develop commercial awareness and build skills that will prepare you for a successful career in Talent Acquisition, People Operations or Human Resources.
   

  

 If you're naturally curious, love solving problems, enjoy building relationships and want to understand how high\-performing technology companies attract exceptional people, this internship will give you the experience, coaching and ownership to accelerate your career.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 From your first week, you'll become an active member of the Talent Acquisition team rather than simply observing from the sidelines. You'll work with the recruiter(s) to support our hiring efforts across Bangalore and Delhi; through this, you will learn how hiring decisions influence the growth of a global SaaS company.
   

  

 You'll review inbound applications to understand what separates good candidates from truly exceptional ones, developing your ability to assess capability, potential and alignment to Sitetracker's Performance Based Hiring methodology.
   

  

 You'll support the coordination and scheduling of interviews across multiple time zones, ensuring candidates and interviewers have a seamless experience throughout the recruitment process.
   

  

 As one of the first people that many candidates meet when interviewing with Sitetracker, you'll help create an exceptional first impression by welcoming candidates during in\-person interviews at the office, helping them feel comfortable, and ensuring every interaction reflects our values and employer brand.
   

  

 You'll also contribute to employer branding initiatives, university engagement, talent community building and recruitment marketing activities that strengthen Sitetracker's reputation as an employer of choice.
   

  

 Along the way, you'll help improve how we work by supporting recruiting operations, maintaining accurate data within Lever, creating recruiting dashboards and market insights, and identifying opportunities to automate repetitive work using AI tools.
   

  

 As your confidence grows, you'll take increasing ownership of sourcing projects, employer branding initiatives and process improvements, giving you exposure to every stage of the recruitment lifecycle.
   

  

**The Skills You'll Have**
**Communication \& Relationship Building**
* Demonstrate confident written and verbal communication.
* Represent Sitetracker professionally with candidates, hiring managers and interviewers.
* Create a welcoming and memorable experience for every candidate throughout their interview journey.
* Adapt communication style to suit different audiences and situations.


**Talent Intelligence \& Sourcing**
* Review inbound applications and recognize the characteristics that differentiate exceptional talent.
* Build and analyze internal applicant talent pools and provide insights that influence recruiting strategy.
* Develop an understanding of enterprise SaaS hiring and competitive talent landscapes.


**Organisation, Candidate Experience \& Continuous Improvement**
* Manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
* Coordinate interviews across multiple calendars and international time zones.
* Keep candidate information accurate and organised within recruiting systems.
* Deliver timely, thoughtful communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Demonstrate ownership, curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset in everything you do.


**Within 30 Days, You'll**
* Complete onboarding across our recruiting technology, AI tools and Talent Acquisition processes.
* Develop a strong understanding of Sitetracker's products, customers, values and Performance\-Based Hiring methodology.
* Learn how recruiters evaluate candidates by reviewing inbound applications alongside the Talent Acquisition team.
* Begin supporting interview scheduling.
* Welcome candidates during in\-person interviews at the office and help deliver an exceptional first impression of Sitetracker.


**Within 90 Days, You'll**
* Review inbound applications and confidently recommend candidates for recruiter review.
* Build talent pools from inbound applicants that support hiring initiatives.
* Coordinate interviews across global teams while maintaining an exceptional candidate experience.
* Create personalised outreach campaigns using AI to improve engagement and efficiency.
* Contribute to employer branding, university outreach or recruitment marketing initiatives.


**Within 180 Days, You'll**
* Consistently deliver high\-quality inbound candidate pipelines for assigned searches.
* Demonstrate the ability to distinguish high\-potential candidates through application reviews and recruiter calibration sessions.
* Be recognised as a trusted member of the Talent Acquisition team who consistently demonstrates Sitetracker's values of Intense Competence, Act with Agency, Build for Tomorrow and Rigorous not Ruthless.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a
 **Talent Acquisition Intern** 
 , you’ll work closely with the People team and get hands\-on exposure to how hiring works at a fast\-growing startup.
   

  

 You’ll work across tech and non\-tech roles in India and international markets, and contribute across the hiring journey, from finding great candidates to helping close them.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership internship for someone who wants to learn quickly, work closely with recruiters and hiring managers, and understand what it takes to build exceptional teams.
   

  

**The Job**
* Build strong talent pipelines by sourcing candidates through LinkedIn, job platforms, referrals and creative channels.
* Own candidate coordination across screening, interviews, follow\-ups and hiring team communication.
* Deliver a great candidate experience by keeping communication clear, timely and thoughtful throughout the process.
* Keep hiring operations sharp by maintaining accurate ATS data, recruitment trackers and hiring reports.
* Contribute beyond day\-to\-day hiring through employer branding, campus hiring, hiring analytics and process improvement projects.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Is curious about recruitment and excited to learn how high\-performing teams are built.
* Has strong communication, organisation and follow\-through.
* Takes ownership, pays attention to detail and does not need to be chased to get things done.
* Can manage multiple priorities and stay organised in a fast\-moving environment.
* Prior exposure to recruitment, campus placements, sourcing or people\-related projects is a plus, but not required.


**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

description:
**Company:** 
  Scale 100X.ai by Expertrons
 



**Location:** 
  Andheri East
 



**Internship Tenure** 
 : (6\-Month Internship \+ PPO Guaranteed on Performance)
 



**Stipend:** 
 Upto
 
 Rs.10,000
 



**Designation:** 
 Talent Acquisition Intern
 



  





**We’re growing our team.** 




 In addition to this role, we have multiple openings across functions.
 



 If you’re interested in exploring other opportunities, please find the links to all active roles here:
 



  





**About the Opportunity** 




  





 This internship is a
 **career\-launchpad** 
 for individuals who want to build a strong foundation in Talent Acquisition. You will gain end\-to\-end exposure to sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordination, and hiring strategy while working closely with senior HR leaders.
 



  





 We are looking for
 **highly motivated MBA freshers and fresh graduates** 
 who wish to kickstart their career in the Talent Acquisition domain with structured learning, strong mentorship, and a clear path toward career advancement.
 



  





 After
 **6 months, a Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO)** 
 will be extended based on
 **consistent performance, ownership, and onboarding numbers.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Talent Sourcing \& Pipeline Development** 



* Source talent through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals \& internal databases
* Build a strong, high\-quality candidate pipeline across multiple functions, with a special focus on Sales hiring



**Screening \& Shortlisting** 



* Review resumes and conduct initial telephonic screenings
* Evaluate candidates based on job criteria
* Follow up consistently to reduce drop\-offs and improve joining rates.



**Coordination \& Candidate Experience** 



* Schedule interviews with hiring managers
* Maintain professional, timely candidate communications



**Onboarding \& Documentation** 



* Coordinate offer rollouts \& joining formalities with HR Ops



**Internal Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate daily/weekly hiring trackers
* Share recruitment insights \& performance reports



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* MBA fresher or fresh graduate (any discipline; HR preferred)
* Passionate about Talent Acquisition and people engagement
* Excellent communication \& interpersonal skills
* Highly organized, proactive, self\-motivated, and eager to learn
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable with Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy



**Why Join Us?** 



* Guaranteed PPO based on transparent performance metrics
* High learning exposure across the full recruitment cycle
* Opportunity to grow rapidly within the HR function
* Open, collaborative, and dynamic work culture
* Opportunities to transition into HR Ops, HRBP, or Strategic HR depending on your interest \& performance



**Your Growth Path:** 




  





 Your growth here is simple: the more smoothly you manage the hiring process and support successful onboardings, the faster you grow.
 


* **Weeks 1–2: Getting Started:** 
 You quickly settle into our processes, begin sourcing for active roles, and support candidates through the early stages of the funnel — contributing to onboarding readiness from the start.
* 
* **Months 1–2: Building Confidence:** 
 You start handling roles more independently, coordinating interviews, maintaining pipelines, and assisting candidates through to offer and joining.
* 
* **Months 3–4: Taking Steady Ownership:** 
 You manage multiple roles comfortably, maintain consistent communication with selected candidates, and help ensure smooth, timely onboardings.
* 
* **Months 5–6: Full Flow \& PPO Evaluation:** 
 You handle end\-to\-end hiring with confidence, support predictable onboarding cycles, and demonstrate consistency — leading to your performance\-based PPO.



 The PPO serves as a transition into a full\-time role where you continue to grow within Talent Acquisition or explore adjacent HR verticals, depending on your interest. The more value you add and the more dependable you become in the onboarding process, the stronger your PPO pathway becomes.
 



  





**Kickstart your Talent Acquisition career, make a real impact from day one, and secure your PPO by driving successful onboardings!** 




  





**Interested candidates can fill out the form below so that we can connect with you.** 




  





**About the company \-** 
**Scale100x.ai** 




  





 We are the world’s first AI\-powered growth accelerator helping consumer brands scale through partner\-led expansion. Founded by IIT Bombay alumni and serial entrepreneurs behind Expertrons, the team has built and exited ventures to public\-listed companies and scaled 300\+ franchise networks across sectors.
 



  





 We support high\-potential brands by building 100\+ outlets or partners annually, leveraging AI\-driven sales, marketing, and operational execution, driving profitability through data\-led processes, assisting with fundraising, investor relations, and IPO preparedness, and providing a proprietary AI\-based scalability score to guide long\-term growth.
 



  





 In the last year, we’ve driven growth across EV, F\&B, Retail, Salon, EdTech, Play Areas, and more — including enabling a partner brand to raise $5\.4M in Series A.
 



  





 We are now expanding our team to build the next generation of high\-growth consumer brands in India and globally. If you want to work at the intersection of AI, growth, franchising, and venture building, Scale100x.ai is the place to be.
 



  





 Founded by 
 **IIT Bombay alumni Vivek Gupta and Jatin Solanki** 
 , 100X Growth Partners brings together deep industry expertise and a successful track record of scaling brands across sectors. Our mission is simple yet impactful—to drive rapid and profitable growth through franchising. From developing customized franchise models to providing full\-spectrum support across marketing, recruitment, legal, and operational execution, we ensure our partners are set up for long\-term success.

title: Assistant Manager Human Resources
description:
About the Role
 



 We're looking for a Senior HR Manager who has lived inside a high\-volume retail or QSR environment and knows what it takes to keep dozens of stores fully staffed, well\-trained and motivated. This is a hands\-on, build\-and\-scale role, not a maintenance one. You'll own the full people lifecycle for our frontline and store\-management teams across three cities, and you'll be the person who makes sure our headcount keeps pace with our store rollout without sacrificing quality of hire.
 



 You'll partner directly with the MD, cluster managers and the training function, and you'll bring the systems, discipline and energy needed to run HR at scale across a distributed network.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Own high\-volume recruitment for store crew, shift leads and store managers across all three cities, building a pipeline that stays ahead of the store\-opening calendar.
* Build and maintain a sourcing engine (referrals, hyperlocal channels, institutes, gig platforms) that fills frontline roles fast and at the right cost\-per\-hire.
* Forecast manpower needs against the expansion plan and new\-store launch timelines.



**Retention \& Engagement** 



* Tackle frontline attrition head\-on — diagnose root causes, design interventions, and bring measurable improvement to retention and tenure.
* Run engagement, recognition and feedback mechanisms suited to a young, distributed, shift\-based workforce.



**Performance, Training \& Development** 



* Partner with the Head of Training to ensure every new hire moves through structured onboarding and sign\-off gates before going live on the floor.
* Drive a clear performance\-management rhythm across stores, including goal\-setting, reviews and career pathing for high performers.



**HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Own statutory and labour\-law compliance across all locations — Shops \& Establishments, PF, ESI, minimum wages, contract labour and store\-level documentation.
* Standardise HR processes, policies, SOPs and the HRIS so the system scales cleanly as store count grows.
* Manage payroll inputs, attendance discipline, grievance handling and disciplinary processes fairly and consistently.



**Franchise \& Multi\-City Support** 



* Define people standards, hiring frameworks and training expectations that franchise partners adopt to keep service quality consistent network\-wide.
* Act as the central HR point of contact for cluster managers in Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad.



 What We're Looking For
 


* 8\+ years in HR, with at least 4 in a senior role within QSR, food \& beverage retail, organised retail or a multi\-outlet chain.
* Proven track record managing high\-volume frontline recruitment and reducing attrition in a shift\-based workforce.

* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent preferred.

 Your Impact

* Experience with systems including Workday, HR Acuity, Slack and Google
* Creates and executes influence strategies that persuade key stakeholders to take action that will advance shared interest and business goals.

title: HRBP
description:
**Overview**
 Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.
   

  

 Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in\-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favourite sports teams and competitions.
   

  

**How do we add value?**
* Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.
* Sportsbooks can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.
* The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.
* Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.


 Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.
   

  

 We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real\-time data with our 40\-year\-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Mission Statement: The HRBP acts as a strategic and operational HR leader for the India business, partnering with business leaders to align people strategy, workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, and employee engagement with company objectives. The role also leads the local HR Shared Services (HRSS) team, ensuring high\-quality HR operations, governance, employee support, and compliance with statutory and company standards.
* Business Impact: This role contributes directly to organizational performance through effective people partnership, leadership support, employee relations management, workforce governance, and delivery of scalable HR operations. The role supports talent retention, operational efficiency, compliance, and employee experience while ensuring alignment with global HR standards and business priorities.
* Decision\-making Authority: The role holds responsibility for advising and influencing leaders on workforce decisions, employee relations matters, organizational design, performance management, and HR governance within defined company policies and statutory frameworks. The position also oversees prioritization and execution of HRSS operational activities, escalates business risks where required, and drives alignment between local execution and global HR direction.


**Required Qualifications:**
* Operational Management: Oversee day\-to\-day HR operations and HR Shared Services delivery for the India population. Lead and manage a team of 4–5 HRSS employees, ensuring service quality, responsiveness, and operational efficiency. Ensure accurate employee lifecycle management, HR data governance, compliance, and documentation standards. Manage employee relations cases, disciplinary actions, grievances, and escalation handling.
* Strategic Execution: Partner with business and operational leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, and talent initiatives. Drive performance management processes, leadership capability development, and retention initiatives. Support organizational change, restructuring, and transformation activities.
* Stakeholder Partnering: Act as trusted advisor to managers and senior business leaders across the India organization. Collaborate with global HR teams including Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Rewards, HR Operations, and Learning \& Development. Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on employee risk mitigation and governance matters.
* Service Delivery: Ensure timely and accurate resolution of HR queries, employee requests, and HR operational activities. Drive continuous improvement, process optimization, and operational efficiency initiatives.
* People Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the local HR Shared Services team. Drive accountability, prioritization, collaboration, and development within the team. Foster a high\-performance, compliant, and employee\-focused HR culture.
* Financial Responsibility and Revenue Impact: Supports workforce cost management, headcount governance, and organizational efficiency initiatives. Contributes to operational effectiveness through optimized HR processes and controlled people\-related risk management.


**Desired Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related discipline required. MBA or postgraduate HR qualification preferred.
* 15\+ years of HR experience within HR Business Partnering and/ or HR Operations environments.
* Prior experience leading HR operational or HR Shared Services teams preferred.


**Why work at Stats Perform?**
**We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!**
 We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.
   

  

**We take care of our colleagues**
 We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.
   

  

**We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.**
 We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform**
 By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.
   

  

 With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

title: Specialist Manager-Talent Operations - Risk & Relations - Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Built on Deloitte’s USI Talent Risk \& Relations practice, this role helps address employee risk matters across the organization through investigations, consultations, and issue resolution. The Specialist Manager, Talent Risk and Relations will manage complex talent relations matters, advise stakeholders on employment risk, and support fair, consistent outcomes. This role also helps identify trends, strengthen risk mitigation, and support programs that promote policy awareness and appropriate workplace conduct.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Specialist Manager, Talent Risk and Relations on the Talent Risk \& Relations team, you will be responsible for…
   

  

* Manage complex talent relations matters, including policy violations, behavioral misconduct, harassment matters, performance concerns, and grievance cases.
* Conduct investigations, document findings, and provide recommendations to mitigate employment risk and support fair, consistent outcomes.
* Partner with Talent Business Advisors, business leaders, Office of General Counsel, Office of Security, Talent Acquisition, and other stakeholders to address employee risk matters.
* Support Internal Complaints Committee activities, facilitate awareness sessions on conduct and policy topics, and manage case tracking through the case management system.
* Identify case trends, recommend interventions to reduce risk, and provide guidance to Talent Risk \& Relations analysts on case handling and background check matters.
* Support crisis response and medical accommodation matters as needed.


**The team**
 Talent Risk \& Relations focuses on employee risks across all levels caused by either behavioral or external factors (e. g., investigations, consultations, and crisis matter). Talent Relations brings specialized skills and an integrated approach effectively addressing employee risks and people issues.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Personnel Management, Social Work, or a related discipline
* 8\-10 years of experience, including 6\+ years in talent relations or employee relations
* Experience conducting workplace investigations, grievance handling, and crisis management
* Experience serving on or supporting an Internal Complaints Committee under the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Act
* Experience advising business leaders and Human Resources stakeholders on employee risk matters
* Experience using case management systems to log, track, and manage cases


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience managing background check case reviews and assigning case work across a team
* Experience facilitating classroom or virtual training on code of conduct, workplace behavior, or policy awareness
* Experience supporting medical accommodation matters
* Experience partnering with legal, security, and talent stakeholders on sensitive employee matters
* Experience providing guidance or coaching to junior team members


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

description:
**Job Description**
 As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the world’s top professional services firms, and in support of our global workforce strategy, we’re growing our operations in India! We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!
   

  

 CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia. We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Associate to join the Advisory team in our National Advisory practice.
   

  

 CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered hybrid which means team members are expected to be thoughtful and intentional in how they create opportunities for in\-person collaboration. While the cadence of in\-office presence is determined at the team level, our professionals are encouraged to be in the office/together in person on average 3 days a week.
   

  

 YOUR TEAM. This position will support our Advisory – CXO team and as an Audit Industry Associate, you will be part of a dynamic team delivering high\-quality audit and assurance services to clients in the CHAMP sectors. You will work closely with clients and internal teams to understand industry\-specific challenges and provide actionable insights that drive business performance. WHY COHNREZNICK? At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm. We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
   

  

 YOUR ROLE.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To**
 Strategy \& Transformation
   

  

* Support enterprise, functional, and digital transformation initiatives
* Assist with current\-state assessments, data gathering, and documentation of processes
* Help prepare analysis, summaries, and materials that support strategic recommendations
* Contribute to implementation plans, roadmaps, and performance tracking tools


 Technology \& Data Enablement
   

  

* Support technology strategy, system selection, and implementation efforts (e.g., ERP, CRM, dataplatforms, etc.)

* Support change management activities, including documentation and user support materials


 Client Delivery \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Support project teams by preparing client\-ready presentations and working documents
* Participate in client meetings, workshops, and working sessions as a supporting team member
* Collaborate with teammates across functions and backgrounds in a team\-oriented environment


 Analytics \& Problem Solving
   

  

* Perform quantitative and qualitative analysis under guidance
* Help organize, validate, and synthesize data into clear findings
* Apply structured problem\-solving methodologies to solve problems


 Team Leadership \& Firm Contribution
   

  

* Contribute to internal knowledge development, methodologies, and practice initiatives
* Mentor and coach Interns, providing feedback and quality review


**Requirements**
* Prior internship or project\-based experience in consulting, analytics, technology, or operationspreferred
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, computer science, engineering, or a relatedfield
* MBA or a master’s degree is preferred
* Process improvement mindset going above and beyond to identify operational inefficiencies andtaking steps to improve processes and automating repetitive tasks
* Experience with flow charting or mind mapping tools preferred
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Excellent problem\-solving skills; demonstrated ability to analyze a problem from different angles/approaches
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational skills
* Ambitious learner with a passion for expanding their knowledge
* Demonstrated understanding of use and application of automation and AI to transform business processes preferred
* Willingness to travel to meet client needs


**We Offer**
* Endless opportunities to contribute to one of the largest professional services firm in the US
* A unique culture that values collaboration in everything we do
* A team of professionals driven by a sense of excellence, integrity, commitment to lifelong learning, respect for one another, adaptability, and making a difference
* A network of 2,700 professionals committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and giving back to the communities in which we live and work
* Varied career paths supported by strong professional development programs and resources
* A flexible work environment with competitive benefits
* Willingness to travel to meet client need


 In addition, please take a moment to review our Universal Job Standards.
   

  

 Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.
   

  

 "CohnReznick" is the brand name under which CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC and their respective subsidiaries provide professional services. CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiaries) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. CohnReznick LLP is a licensed CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC and its subsidiaries are not licensed CPA firms.
   

  

 CohnReznick is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team to drive business results and create a better future every day for our team members, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: Data Analyst

 Every function here \- growth, operations, product, client success runs on the same warehouse. We need an analyst who owns that layer: builds it in dbt, keeps it trustworthy as the logic underneath changes, and turns it into visibility people actually use.
 



 This is not a report\-pulling job. It is equal parts data engineering discipline and business judgement \- you will be asked what the number means, not just what it is.

* Build and maintain scalable dbt models across staging, intermediate, and smart layers with proper testing, documentation, and version control.

* Maintain data accuracy and representation across key datasets, dashboards, MIS reports, and RevOps data flows.

* Work with cross\-functional teams to translate business questions into clear requirements, analyses, and timely insights.



  





**Requirements** 



* 1\+ years of relevant experience in Analytics, BI, or Data Engineering roles.
* Strong SQL skills with experience writing and optimizing queries on large relational databases.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to understand complex data, schemas, ETLs, and business logic.
* Experience building dbt models for warehousing that integrate data across new and legacy infrastructure.
* Experience investigating RCAs and resolving data discrepancies.
* Strong business judgement with the ability to use data to influence decisions and identify growth opportunities.

**Associate Industrial Engineer (P1\)**
**Job Description Summary**
 Analog Devices is seeking an Associate Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This early\-career role will support factory performance improvement initiatives across multiple wafer fabrication sites through capacity modeling, data analytics, reporting automation, cycle time reduction, and scheduling optimization. Working alongside experienced Industrial Engineers at local facilities, this position will contribute to the development of cross\-site analytical tools and decision\-support systems that maximize factory output and enable future expansion planning.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support development and maintenance of cross\-site capacity models, factory loadings, and utilization analyses.
* Assist with cycle time improvement initiatives through bottleneck analysis, WIP management, and line balancing activities.
* Analyze factory performance data and identify opportunities to increase throughput, productivity, and equipment utilization.
* Develop and automate reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other business intelligence tools.
* Support validation of manufacturing scheduling data, forecasting models, and factory planning assumptions.
* Participate in scenario analysis and what\-if modeling to evaluate capacity, output, and resource requirements.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, IT, and Equipment Engineering to support improvement projects.
* Document methodologies, analytical models, and standard work processes.
* Present findings and recommendations to technical and operations teams.
* Build knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing systems, Industrial Engineering methodologies, and factory scheduling concepts.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Analytics, or related engineering discipline.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Internship, co\-op, or academic project experience in manufacturing, operations research, data analytics, or process optimization.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools.
* Coursework in statistics, simulation, optimization, data science, or manufacturing systems.
* Exposure to semiconductor manufacturing or other high\-volume manufacturing environments.


**Work Experience**
* 0–2 years of Industrial Engineering or analytical experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and perform quantitative analysis.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively within geographically distributed teams.

 Data Mining \- Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.

title: AI Associate
description:
**The Role**




 We are looking for an
 

 AI Associate with
 
**1–2 years of experience** 

 who wants to build AI systems that actually make it into users' hands. You’ll work across our core AI solution suite Lattice, with a particular focus on
 
 SynSights
 
 , our AI powered conversational analytics platform.
 



  
 



 Your job is to help us keep making that system better. This is not a role where you spend six months building isolated proof\-of\-concepts that never leave a notebook. You’ll be working on an existing production codebase: developing new features, improving agent workflows, building APIs, working through data problems, fixing things that don't behave the way they should, and taking features from an idea through to something deployed and usable. We don't expect you to know everything on Day 1\. We do expect you to be able to figure things out. No defined playbook, I'm afraid. If shipping working solutions every fortnight, and explaining what you've built to Senior Leadership as fluently as to a fellow engineer is the kind of work that gets you out of bed in the morning, we'd very much like to hear from you.
 



  
 



**What You'll Own**



1. **AI \& Agentic Development:** 

 Build and improve AI workflows using Python, LangChain, and LangGraph. You’ll work on agent orchestration, tool calling, MCP, structured LLM interactions, context handling, memory, retrieval, validation, and the guardrails required to turn an AI workflow into a reliable product.
2. **SynSights Development:** 

 Take ownership of features within SynSights, our conversational analytics platform. That means understanding an existing system before changing it, adding capabilities without breaking what already works, debugging across components, and continuously improving the quality of the answers and analysis the platform produces.
3. **Data Modelling:** 

 Understand unfamiliar client datasets, work out what the tables and columns actually represent, establish relationships between datasets, map business concepts to the underlying data, and structure that understanding so both the application and its AI agents can use it reliably. Work confidently with PostgreSQL: writing and debugging SQL, designing and evolving schemas, understanding joins and relationships, working with large analytical datasets, and thinking about query correctness and performance rather than treating the database as somewhere data happens to live.
4. **Semantic understanding \& context:** 
 Help translate raw client data into something an AI system can reason over. You’ll work with schema relationships, metadata, data mappings, metrics, and business definitions so that the platform understands the difference between a column name and what that column actually means.
5. **API Development:** 
 Build and maintain production APIs using FastAPI, including request/response models, authentication\-aware endpoints, database interactions, service integrations, error handling, and the backend contracts consumed by the frontend.
6. **Cloud Infra \& Deployment (AWS / Azure):** 

 Architect and implement solutions across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, etc.), ensuring flexibility, performance, scalability, and cost\-efficiency. Apply Kubernetes and containerisation best practices to deploy and orchestrate cloud\-native and GenAI/ AI\-ML workloads, with security frameworks across APIs, identity, and access management (SSO, RBAC) built in from the start.
7. **CI/CD and DevOps:** 

 GitHub Actions, pipelines, and the practices that keep deployments consistent and the team moving.
8. **Frontend Integration:** 
 You don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you do need enough exposure to modern frontend development to trace functionality end to end, understand API integration, make smaller UI changes where needed, and work effectively across the boundary between backend and frontend.
9. **End\-to\-End Ownership:** 

 Take a task from requirement to implementation to deployment. Ask questions when the requirement genuinely needs clarification; make sensible assumptions when it doesn't. "My part was done" isn't particularly useful if the feature still doesn't work.



  
 



**What You Bring**



1. 1–2 years of experience in AI engineering, software engineering, data engineering and experience working with large analytical datasets, query optimisation, partitioning, rollups, or data\-ingestion pipelines.
2. Strong hands\-on Python fundamentals. You should be comfortable reading an unfamiliar Python codebase, debugging it, extending it, and structuring your own code properly.
3. Practical experience with LangChain and LangGraph, with an understanding of how LLM applications move beyond a single prompt into stateful workflows, agents, tools, routing, memory, and multi\-step execution.
4. Working knowledge of vector search and retrieval systems, particularly OpenSearch or equivalent vector databases/search engines.
5. Knowledge of MCP / FastMCP and how tool\-based communication fits into modern agentic systems. You should understand how to define and expose tools, connect tools to agents, and build reliable agent\-to\-tool and service\-to\-agent communication.
6. Experience building APIs with FastAPI or a comparable Python API framework.
7. Strong working knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL. Joins, aggregations, CTEs, schemas, relationships, query debugging, and database interactions should be familiar territory.
8. A genuinely good understanding of data. Given a set of unfamiliar tables, you should be able to investigate them, understand how they relate, identify keys and useful fields, map business requirements onto them, and reason about whether the resulting analysis actually makes sense.
9. Experience with data modelling and data mapping, particularly translating messy source data into structures that applications and analytical systems can reliably consume.
10. Working knowledge of AWS, particularly services such as RDS, S3, Lambda, EventBridge, ECR, ECS/Fargate, and EKS. We don't expect you to have operated every service independently in production, but cloud architecture and deployment shouldn't be completely new territory. Familiarity with Docker, containers, APIs, Git, and modern software\-development practices. Solid grasp of
 
 cloud\-native design
 
 : cost optimisation, security, and performance tuning, and the trade\-offs between all three.
11. Experience working on conversational analytical solutions, or systems where an AI\-generated answer must remain grounded in real data.



  
 



**Bonus Points**



* Industry experience in Finance, Telecom, Retail, or CPG.
* Practical exposure to machine learning on large datasets, including preparing training data, training and evaluating models, and working with forecasting and prediction problems.
* Hands\-on work building AI agents, agentic orchestration, or LLM/SLM\-based workflow automation: MCPs, microservices, token and cost optimisation, model selection, prompt engineering, and context window trade\-offs.
* Data engineering or analytics background: building analytics\-ready datasets, cataloguing, metadata management, and governance frameworks. Exposure to predictive analytics or applied forecasting.




  
 




**The Mindset We're Hiring For**




 A figure\-it\-out mindset. Someone comfortable with ambiguity, proactive in problem solving, and genuinely curious about what's next. You ask the right questions, make reasonable assumptions, ship something, and iterate. You own what you build and can defend it confidently in a client room, even when the client has opinions.
 




  
 




**Why SynaptyX**




 You will not be working on anything that lives in a PowerPoint. Our Solutions are in client hands and being improved every sprint. Your contributions are visible and attributable. The team is small, senior, and low\-ego, built on Big 4 advisory depth and serious AI engineering. You will have the authority that matches the accountability. We move fast. Terrifyingly fast, by most corporate standards.
 








**✅** 

 Do:
 
 tell us about the hardest technical trade\-off you've made under delivery pressure, and what you'd do differently.
 



 ❌
 
 Don't:
 
 send "passionate about cloud and AI" with no evidence. We'll assume you mean passionate about the phrase.

The ideal candidate will have a solid track record of designing, developing, and implementing end‑to‑end BI solutions, transforming raw data into actionable insights, and collaborating closely with cross‑functional stakeholders to support data‑driven decision‑making. Additionally, the candidate will possess a strong background in data and business analysis, along with analytical and communications skills.

* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including Data Engineering, Analytics, and IT Infrastructure.

* Experience implementing data level security using Section Access and RLS.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modelling, and relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, etc.).
* Experience integrating BI tools with varied data sources—databases, APIs, flat files, etc.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and data manipulation.
* Good understanding of ETL processes and tools.
* Excellent problem‑solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.

* Experience of Finance domain, specifically Fixed Income, would be an added advantage.

 The QA Engineer is responsible for validating customer implementations, platform features, web applications, configuration scenarios, APIs, data\-driven workflows, and AI\-enabled capabilities across Digital \& Transformation. This role sits within the Solutions Engineering section as part of a QA team that supports quality across implementation, engineering, and platform delivery.
   

  

 This role sits within Digital \& Transformation, helping to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification \& Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.
   

  

 Working in close partnership with Solutions Engineering, Data \& AI Engineering, Application Engineering, Product leadership, Platform Reliability, and Solution Architecture, this role helps ensure that web applications, APIs, low\-code and hybrid platform configurations, AI outputs, and customer\-specific workflows meet functional, quality, security, and production readiness expectations.
   

  

 The QA Engineer supports both manual and automated validation, including regression testing, exploratory testing, implementation testing, User Acceptance Testing support, API testing, data validation, AI accuracy checks, load and performance testing, and quality controls for new platform capabilities and customer configurations.
   

  

 This role plays a key part in improving delivery quality, reducing regression risk, strengthening release confidence, and ensuring new capabilities are reliable before they reach production environments. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, organized, analytical, and comfortable working across implementation, application engineering, data engineering, and AI\-enabled platform delivery.
   

  

 \*\*This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role\-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.\*\*
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Assurance \& Test Delivery**
* Develop and execute test plans for web applications, APIs, platform features, data workflows, AI\-enabled capabilities, and customer\-specific configurations.
* Apply strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to isolate defects, identify reliable reproduction scenarios, and distinguish application defects from data, configuration, integration, or environment issues.
* Validate functional correctness, workflow behavior, business rules, data loads, integrations, permissions, user\-facing outcomes, and platform configuration scenarios.
* Support User Acceptance Testing, implementation quality reviews, release validation, and production readiness for customer implementations.
* Document defects, reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, test results, risks, and validation evidence clearly and consistently.
* Work with implementation and engineering teams to confirm fixes, validate changes, and reduce recurring quality issues.
* Apply strong testing fundamentals while adapting validation practices to both custom software and low\-code or hybrid platform delivery.


**Automation \& Regression Testing**
* Build, maintain, and execute automated regression tests for platform features, web applications, APIs, configuration scenarios, and customer implementation patterns.
* Identify application workflows, APIs, and platform capabilities where load or performance testing is appropriate, and support the development and execution of those tests.
* Partner with Application Engineering, Data \& AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, and Platform Reliability to integrate automated tests into CI/CD and release processes.
* Identify repeatable validation needs and convert them into reusable automated test coverage where appropriate.
* Support test data preparation, environment readiness, smoke testing, regression testing, and release validation.
* Help maintain test suites that improve confidence across platform changes, configuration updates, API changes, and customer\-specific implementations.
* Contribute to automation patterns that improve speed, consistency, and traceability of QA work.


**AI Quality \& Validation**
* Capture failed extractions, edge cases, inconsistent outputs, prompt issues, unexpected AI behavior, and quality trends for review by Solutions Engineering and Data \& AI Engineering.
* Support evaluation practices for AI accuracy, consistency, regression risk, and customer\-specific acceptance criteria.
* Help ensure AI\-enabled features are tested for reliability, traceability, explainability where appropriate, and operational readiness.
* Maintain appropriate human review, documentation, and validation evidence for AI\-enabled workflows before production use.


**Low\-Code, Hybrid Platform \& Application Testing**
* Test low\-code, no\-code, and hybrid platform configurations including workflows, business rules, forms, data loads, permissions, prompts, user journeys, and integrations.
* Support consistent quality practices across both custom engineering and configuration\-led delivery.
* Validate that configured solutions connect correctly with data services, AI\-enabled features, application workflows, APIs, authentication patterns, and customer\-facing delivery processes.


**Data, API \& Integration Testing**
* Validate APIs, data services, data loads, data transformations, extracted outputs, and integration behavior across platform workflows.
* Support testing of data\-driven features, reporting outputs, structured review workflows, and customer\-facing delivery processes.
* Verify that data used in applications, workflows, AI features, and customer deliverables is accurate, complete, and aligned with expected business rules.
* Partner with Data \& AI Engineering to validate extraction workflows, data quality checks, AI\-ready data outputs, and downstream platform behavior.
* Document data quality issues, mismatches, transformation errors, and integration defects clearly for engineering and implementation teams.


**Modern Development \& AI\-Enabled Testing**
* Use AI\-assisted methods where appropriate to support test case generation, exploratory testing ideas, documentation, and defect investigation.
* Contribute to reusable testing patterns, documentation, and validation approaches that improve QA team consistency and delivery speed.


**DevOps, Reliability \& Security**
* Support integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and release validation processes.
* Support deployment readiness, regression testing, smoke testing, and production validation where appropriate.


**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**
* Communicate quality risks, test results, blockers, defects, and validation status clearly and consistently.
* Proactively identify ambiguous requirements, acceptance criteria, and unexpected behaviors, and work with Product, Engineering, and QA stakeholders to clarify expected outcomes before or during testing.
* Contribute to QA standards, test documentation, automation patterns, validation templates, and reusable quality practices.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, defect triage, release planning, and retrospective discussions where appropriate.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, customer focus, and delivery excellence.


 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 \*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
   

  

 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2–3 years of experience in software quality assurance, test automation, software testing, implementation validation, platform validation, or related roles.
* Experience with exploratory testing, defect investigation, and developing clear and reproducible defect scenarios.
* Familiarity with low\-code, no\-code, or hybrid development environments.
* Experience building, maintaining, or executing automated regression tests.
* Experience with test case design, defect management, test planning, release validation, and User Acceptance Testing support.
* Ability to validate functional correctness, data\-driven workflows, and AI\-enabled outputs with strong attention to detail.
* Familiarity with CI/CD processes, source control, test automation practices, and modern software delivery methods.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work through structured backlogs, delivery plans, task tracking, or equivalent delivery methods.


**What Is Preferred**
* Experience supporting interoperability across multiple systems or enterprise platforms.
* Experience with load, performance, or scalability testing of web applications or APIs.
* Experience with collaborative due diligence, document review, workflow, reporting, Q\&A, risk management, or transaction delivery applications.
* Background in energy, infrastructure, renewables, assurance, certification, or other technically complex industries.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering, implementation, or QA teams..


 Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country\-specific laws and practices.
